# DaVinci Connection Instance Definitions

Below is a list of all available DaVinci Connections available for use in the `pingone_davinci_connector_instance` resource. 
If the `value` type of a property is not defined it must be inferred.


## 1Kosmos connector

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connector1Kosmos`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `authType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `button` (string): Console display name: "OIDC Login".
* `customAuth` (string): Console display name: "".
* `showPoweredBy` (string): Console display name: "".
* `skipButtonPress` (string): Console display name: "".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connector1Kosmos" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connector1Kosmos"
  }
  name = "My awesome connector1Kosmos"
  property {
    name  = "authType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector1kosmos_property_auth_type
  }
  property {
    name  = "button"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector1kosmos_property_button
  }
  property {
    name  = "customAuth"
    type  = "string"
    value = jsonencode({})
  }
  property {
    name  = "showPoweredBy"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector1kosmos_property_show_powered_by
  }
  property {
    name  = "skipButtonPress"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector1kosmos_property_skip_button_press
  }
}
```


## AWS Lambda

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorAWSLambda`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accessKeyId` (string): Access key to connect to AWS Environment. Console display name: "Access Key Id".
* `functionName` (string): AWS Lambda Function Name to Invoke. Console display name: "Lambda Function Name".
* `payload` (string): Optional Payload in Key-Value format. Console display name: "Payload".
* `raw` (string): Optional Raw JSON Payload. Console display name: "Raw JSON Payload".
* `region` (string): AWS Region where the Lambda function is created. Console display name: "AWS Region".
* `secretAccessKey` (string): Secret Key to access the AWS. Console display name: "AWS Secret Key".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connectorAWSLambda" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connectorAWSLambda"
  }
  name = "My awesome connectorAWSLambda"
  property {
    name  = "accessKeyId"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorawslambda_property_access_key_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "functionName"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorawslambda_property_function_name
  }
  property {
    name  = "payload"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorawslambda_property_payload
  }
  property {
    name  = "raw"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorawslambda_property_raw
  }
  property {
    name  = "region"
    type  = "string"
    value = "eu-west-1"
  }
  property {
    name  = "secretAccessKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorawslambda_property_secret_access_key
  }
}
```

## AWS Secrets Manager

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorAmazonAwsSecretsManager`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accessKeyId` (string): The AWS Access Key. Console display name: "AWS Access Key".
* `kmsKeyId` (string): The KMS Key ID, or ARN/alias ARN of the KMS key used to encrypt the secret. Console display name: "KMS Key ID".
* `overwriteIfExists` (string): If the secret already exists, should it be overwritten. Console display name: "Overwrite if exists".
* `recoverFromSoftDelete` (string): If the secret has been deleted and is recoverable, should it be recovered first. Console display name: "Recover Soft Delete".
* `region` (string): The AWS Region. Console display name: "AWS Region".
* `secondaryAccessKeyId` (string): Optional fallback AWS Access Key used if the primary call times out or cannot connect. Console display name: "Secondary AWS Access Key".
* `secondaryRegion` (string): Optional fallback AWS Region used if the primary call times out or cannot connect. Console display name: "Secondary AWS Region".
* `secondarySecretAccessKey` (string): Optional fallback AWS Access Secret used if the primary call times out or cannot connect. Console display name: "Secondary AWS Access Secret".
* `secretAccessKey` (string): The AWS Access Secret. Console display name: "AWS Access Secret".
* `secretDescription` (string): A description of the secret. Console display name: "Description".
* `secretName` (string): The name or ARN of the secret. Console display name: "Secret Name / ARN".
* `secretValue` (string): The secret value. Console display name: "Secret Value".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connectorAmazonAwsSecretsManager" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connectorAmazonAwsSecretsManager"
  }
  name = "My awesome connectorAmazonAwsSecretsManager"
  property {
    name  = "accessKeyId"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_access_key_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "kmsKeyId"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_kms_key_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "overwriteIfExists"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_overwrite_if_exists
  }
  property {
    name  = "recoverFromSoftDelete"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_recover_from_soft_delete
  }
  property {
    name  = "region"
    type  = "string"
    value = "eu-west-1"
  }
  property {
    name  = "secondaryAccessKeyId"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_secondary_access_key_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "secondaryRegion"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_secondary_region
  }
  property {
    name  = "secondarySecretAccessKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_secondary_secret_access_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "secretAccessKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_secret_access_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "secretDescription"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_secret_description
  }
  property {
    name  = "secretName"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_secret_name
  }
  property {
    name  = "secretValue"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoramazonawssecretsmanager_property_secret_value
  }
}
```


## AbuseIPDB

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorAbuseipdb`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiKey` (string): API Key gathered from AbuseIPDB tenant. Console display name: "API Key".
* `ipAddress` (string): IP Address. Console display name: "IP Address".
* `maxDays` (string): Maximum amount of days to look back to. Console display name: "Max Days".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connectorAbuseipdb" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connectorAbuseipdb"
  }
  name = "My awesome connectorAbuseipdb"
  property {
    name  = "apiKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorabuseipdb_property_api_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "ipAddress"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorabuseipdb_property_ip_address
  }
  property {
    name  = "maxDays"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorabuseipdb_property_max_days
  }
}
```


## Accertify

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `AccertifyConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accountCreateFailureCode` (string): Failure code for account create attempts. Console display name: "Account Create Failure Code".
* `accountID` (string): User's unique identifier assigned by your system. Console display name: "Account ID".
* `authenticationMethod` (string): How the user authenticated. Console display name: "Authentication Method".
* `baseUrl` (string): Accertify API base URL (include https://). Console display name: "Base URL".
* `basicAuthPassword` (string): Password used to build the Authorization Basic header for Accertify API requests. Console display name: "Password".
* `basicAuthUsername` (string): Username used to build the Authorization Basic header for Accertify API requests. Console display name: "Username ".
* `brand` (string): The brand submitting the event. For clients with multiple brands under one corporate entity. Maximum field length = 50 characters. Console display name: "Brand".
* `devicePayload` (string): Accertify Device payload from the collector script (recommended over Device Transaction ID). Console display name: "Device Payload".
* `deviceTransactionID` (string): Accertify Device transaction ID from collector JS/SDK (backward compatibility). Console display name: "Device Transaction ID".
* `emailAddress` (string): Email address associated with the account or event. Console display name: "Email Address".
* `eventSource` (string): Where or how the event originated. Console display name: "Event Source".
* `firstName` (string): User's first name. Console display name: "First Name".
* `hashedPassword` (string): Hashed password (do not provide a plaintext password). Console display name: "Hashed Password".
* `ipAddress` (string): User's IP address. Console display name: "IP Address".
* `isMobileAppInstalled` (string): Whether the account has the mobile application installed somewhere. Console display name: "Is Mobile App Installed".
* `lastName` (string): User's last name. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `loginEventFailureCode` (string): Login Event failure code. Console display name: "Failure Code".
* `middleName` (string): User's middle name. Console display name: "Middle Name".
* `pageID` (string): UBA unique page ID defined from the collector script. Console display name: "Page ID".
* `passwordForgotFailureCode` (string): Password Forgot Event failure code. Console display name: "Failure Code".
* `previousAvsResult` (string): Previous AVS result. Console display name: "Previous AVS Result".
* `previousCardBin` (string): Previous leading digits (BIN). Console display name: "Previous Card BIN".
* `previousCardLastFour` (string): Previous last four digits. Console display name: "Previous Card Last Four".
* `previousCardNumber` (string): Previous credit card number (hashed or tokenized). Console display name: "Previous Card Number".
* `previousCvvResult` (string): Previous CVV result. Console display name: "Previous CVV Result".
* `previousEmailAddress` (string): Email address before the account update. Console display name: "Previous Email Address".
* `previousExpirationDay` (string): Previous expiration day (DD). Console display name: "Previous Expiration Day".
* `previousExpirationMonth` (string): Previous expiration month (MM). Console display name: "Previous Expiration Month".
* `previousExpirationYear` (string): Previous expiration year (YYYY). Console display name: "Previous Expiration Year".
* `previousNameOnCreditCard` (string): Previous cardholder name. Console display name: "Previous Name on Card".
* `previousPaymentType` (string): Previous payment method type. Console display name: "Previous Payment Type".
* `success` (string): Whether the event was successful or not. Console display name: "Success".
* `ubaEvents` (string): UBA recent events payload. Console display name: "UBA Events".
* `ubaID` (string): Accertify UBA ID used to reference behavior data. Console display name: "UBA ID".
* `ubaSessionID` (string): The user's Session ID defined by Accertify for the user's web browsing activity. Console display name: "UBA Session ID".
* `updateEventID` (string): eventID that triggered the verification. Console display name: "Update Event ID".
* `updateEventRecommendationDetail` (string): The recommendationDetail returned by Accertify for the original event. Console display name: "Update Event Recommendation Detail".
* `updateEventType` (string): Event type that triggered the verification. Console display name: "Update Event Type".
* `updateTrigger` (string): Trigger that caused the password to be updated. Console display name: "Update Trigger".
* `updatedAvsResult` (string): Updated AVS result. Console display name: "Updated AVS Result".
* `updatedCardBin` (string): Updated leading digits (BIN). Console display name: "Updated Card BIN".
* `updatedCardLastFour` (string): Updated last four digits. Console display name: "Updated Card Last Four".
* `updatedCardNumber` (string): Updated credit card number (hashed or tokenized). Console display name: "Updated Card Number".
* `updatedCvvResult` (string): Updated CVV result. Console display name: "Updated CVV Result".
* `updatedEmailAddress` (string): Email address after the account update. Console display name: "Updated Email Address".
* `updatedExpirationDay` (string): Updated expiration day (DD). Console display name: "Updated Expiration Day".
* `updatedExpirationMonth` (string): Updated expiration month (MM). Console display name: "Updated Expiration Month".
* `updatedExpirationYear` (string): Updated expiration year (YYYY). Console display name: "Updated Expiration Year".
* `updatedNameOnCreditCard` (string): Updated cardholder name. Console display name: "Updated Name on Card".
* `updatedPaymentType` (string): Updated payment method type. Console display name: "Updated Payment Type".
* `userAgent` (string): User agent of the user's browser/OS. Console display name: "User Agent".
* `username` (string): User's username (if applicable). Console display name: "Username".
* `verificationAttempts` (string): Number of attempts the user tried to verify. Console display name: "Verification Attempts".
* `verificationFailureCode` (string): Verification Event failure code. Console display name: "Failure Code".
* `verificationStatus` (string): Status of the verification (mapped to failureCode). Console display name: "Verification Status".
* `verificationType` (string): Kind of verification the user attempted. Console display name: "Verification Type".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "AccertifyConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "AccertifyConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome AccertifyConnector"
  property {
    name  = "accountCreateFailureCode"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.accertifyconnector_property_account_create_failure_code

    name  = "accountID"
```

## ActiveCampaign API

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connector-oai-activecampaignapi`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdDelete_id` (string): Account id. Console display name: "Id".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdGet_id` (string): Account id. Console display name: "Id".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdNotesNoteIdPut_body` (string): Console display name: "Body".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdNotesNoteIdPut_id` (string): Account id. Console display name: "Id".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdNotesNoteIdPut_note_id` (string): Note id. Console display name: "NoteId".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdNotesPost_body` (string): Console display name: "Body".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdNotesPost_id` (string): Account id. Console display name: "Id".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdPut_body` (string): Console display name: "Body".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsIdPut_id` (string): The Account id. Console display name: "Id".
* `apiApiVersionAccountsPost_body` (string): Console display name: "Body".
* `apiApiVersionActivitiesGet_contact` (string): Console display name: "Contact".
* `apiApiVersionCampaignsCampaignIDGet_campaign_id` (string): Console display name: "CampaignID".
* `apiApiVersionCampaignsCampaignIDLinksGet_campaign_id` (string): Console display name: "CampaignID".
* `apiApiVersionContactAutomationsContactAutomationIDDelete_contact_automation_id` (string): Console display name: "ContactAutomationID".
* `apiApiVersionContactAutomationsContactAutomationIDGet_contact_automation_id` (string): ID of the contactAutomation to retrieve  . Console display name: "ContactAutomationID".
* `apiApiVersionContactAutomationsPost_body` (string): Console display name: "Body".
* `apiApiVersionContactListsPost_body` (string): Console display name: "Body".
* `apiApiVersionContactSyncPost_body` (string): Console display name: "Body".
* `apiApiVersionContactTagsPost_body` (string): Console display name: "Body".
* `apiApiVersionContactsContactIdAccountContactsGet_contact_id` (string): Console display name: "ContactId".
* `apiApiVersionContactsContactIdAutomationEntryCountsGet_contact_id` (string): Console display name: "ContactId".
* `apiApiVersionContactsContactIdBounceLogsGet_contact_id` (string): Console display name: "ContactId".

## Adobe Marketo

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `adobemarketoConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `addLeadsArray` (string): Enter the unique ID of the leads to add to the list. Separate multiple values with a comma, such as "456123,987654". Console display name: "Lead IDs".
* `bodyData` (string): The body of the API call. Console display name: "Body".
* `clientId` (string): Your Adobe Marketo client ID. Console display name: "Client ID".
* `clientSecret` (string): Your Adobe Marketo client secret. Console display name: "Client Secret".
* `customAttributes` (string): Additional attributes. Console display name: "Custom Attributes".
* `customEndpoint` (string): This endpoint is added to the base API URL selected in the connector configuration. Remeber to removed "rest/" from the endpoint. Console display name: "Custom Endpoint".
* `customQueryParams` (string): Query parameters for the request. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `email` (string): The user's email address. Console display name: "Email".
* `endpoint` (string): The API endpoint for your Adobe Marketo instance, such as "abc123.mktorest.com/rest". Console display name: "API URL".
* `firstName` (string): The user's first name. Console display name: "First Name".
* `folderList` (string): Select the folder that contains the lists you want information about. Console display name: "Folder".
* `headers` (string): Define additional headers to send to Adobe Marketo. For help, see the API documentation. Console display name: "Additional Headers".
* `lastName` (string): The user's last name. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `leadId` (string): The unique identifier for the lead, such as "318581". Console display name: "Lead ID".
* `listId` (string): The unique ID for the list, such as "56789". Console display name: "List ID".
* `listName` (string): Enter a name for the new list. Console display name: "List Name".
* `method` (string): The HTTP method of the API call. Console display name: "HTTP Method".
* `middleName` (string): The user's middle name. Console display name: "Middle Name".
* `phone` (string): The user's phone number. Console display name: "Phone Number".
* `searchColumn` (string): Select the Marketo lead attribute that you want to search. Console display name: "Search Attribute".
* `searchLeadArray` (string): Enter the values to look for in the search attribute. Separate multiple values with a comma, such as "138273,jsmith@example.com". Console display name: "Search Values".
* `searchListId` (string): The unique ID for the list, such as "56789". Console display name: "List ID".
* `searchListMethod` (string): Select “Use List ID” or “Use List Name” to get information about a single list, or select a folder to get information about all lists within it. Console display name: "Search Type".
* `searchListName` (string): The name of the list to get information about, such as "Founders". Console display name: "List Name".
* `smartListToggle` (string): Select the type of list you are reading. Smart lists support additional accuracy and functionality. Console display name: "List Type".


Example:

```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "adobemarketoConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

    id = "adobemarketoConnector"
  }
```

## Akamai Account Protector

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `akamaiApConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `akamaiUserRiskHeader` (string): HTTP header value that contains the Akamai User Risk score and related signals. Console display name: "Akamai User Risk Header".
* `highValueThreshold` (string): The maximum score for a high risk assessment. Scores above Medium and up to this value are categorized as High risk. Any score above this value are considered Critical risk. Console display name: "High Risk Threshold".
* `mediumValueThreshold` (string): The maximum score for a medium risk assessment. Scores above Low and up to this value are categorized as Medium risk. Console display name: "Medium Risk Threshold".

## Amazon DynamoDB

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorAmazonDynamoDB`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `attrDefinitions` (string): A list of JSON objects containing AttributeName and AttributeType (ex.  [{ AttributeName: 'name', AttributeType 'S'}, {AttributeName: 'age', AttributeType 'N'}] ). Console display name: "List of Attribute Name and Type".
* `attrKeySchema` (string): A list of JSON objects containing AttributeName and KeyType (ex.  [{ AttributeName: 'name', KeyType: 'HASH'}, {AttributeName: 'age', KeyType 'RANGE'}] ). Console display name: "List of Attribute Name and Key Type".
* `awsAccessKey` (string): Your AWS Access Key. Console display name: "AWS Access Key".
* `awsAccessSecret` (string): Access Secret corresponding with Access Key found in Your Security Credentials. Console display name: "AWS Access Secret".
* `awsRegion` (string): The AWS Region you are using the connector for. Console display name: "AWS Region".
* `condtionalExpression` (string): A condition that must be satisfied in order for a conditional update to succeed. Console display name: "Conditional Expression".
* `convertClassInstanceToMap` (string): Whether to convert typeof object to map attribute. Console display name: "Convert Class Instance To Map".
* `convertEmptyValues` (string): Whether to automatically convert empty strings, blobs, and sets to `null`. Console display name: "Convert Empty Values".
* `expressionAttributeNames` (string): Use if your attribute names have conflicts with keywords or you'd like to use placeholders for attribute names. Console display name: "Expression Attribute Names".
* `expressionAttributeValues` (string): One or more values that can be substituted in an expression. Console display name: "Expression Attribute Values".
* `filterExpression` (string): Conditions applied after a Query but before the data is returned. (See connector documentation for further info on FilterExpression). Console display name: "Filter Expression".
* `indexName` (string): The name of an index to query. This index can be any local secondary index or global secondary index on the table. Console display name: "Index Name".
* `itemsJSON` (string): A code field to enter JSON object.  Console display name: "Items (JSON format)".
* `itemsKV` (string): A key-value list of the Attribute-Value pairs of the item. NOTE: All values must be strings. Console display name: "Items Key/Value List".
* `keyConditionExpression` (string): The condition that specifies the key values for items to be retrieved by the Query action. Console display name: "Key Condition Expression".
* `keyJSON` (string): A code field to enter JSON object.  Console display name: "Key of Item (JSON format)".
* `keyKV` (string): A key-value list of the Attribute-Value pairs of the item. NOTE: All values must be strings. Console display name: "Key of Item".
* `limit` (string): The number of results returned by your query (MAX 1MB dataset; if reach MAX returns LastEvaluatedKey). Console display name: "Limit".
* `projectionExpression` (string): A string that identifies one or more attributes to retrieve from the table.  Console display name: "Projection Expression".
* `removeUndefinedValues` (string): Whether to remove undefined values while marshalling. Console display name: "Remove Undefined Values".
* `sdkCommandName` (string): The name of the SDK command you want to call (ex. getObject, createBucket). Console display name: "SDK Custom Call Command Name".
* `sdkParameters` (string): A key value list that will create a JSON object that will be passed as the arguments for your custom command. Console display name: "SDK Custom Call Parameters".
* `tableName` (string): The name of the Table. Console display name: "Table Name".
* `updateExpression` (string): The update expression (ex. ' set info.plot = 'the plot', info.rank = 'the rank' '). Console display name: "Update Expression Clause".
* `wrapNumbers` (string): Whether to return numbers as a string instead of converting them to native JavaScript numbers. Console display name: "Wrap Numbers".

## Argyle

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `argyleConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accountId` (string): Console display name: "Account ID".
* `apiUrl` (string): Console display name: "".
* `backToSearchButtonTitle` (string): The title for the Return to search button in the Success screen. Console display name: "Title for the Return to search button".
* `cantFindLinkItemTitle` (string): The title for the Don’t see your company? button when no Link item is available. By default, this button is not shown if the onCantFindLinkItemClicked callback attribute is not defined. Console display name: "Title for the Don’t see your company".
* `clientId` (string): Console display name: "Client ID".
* `clientSecret` (string): Console display name: "Client Secret".
* `closeOnOutsideClick` (string): Toggles the closing of Link when a user clicks outside the bounds of the UI element provided by Argyle. This flag works only on the web implementation of Argyle Link (and not on the mobile SDKs). Console display name: "Close on outside click".
* `companyName` (string): Your company or app name to display in the UI of Argyle Link (e.g. 'your account is now successfully connected to companyName'). The default value is your company name as entered in the Company Settings section of the Argyle Console. Console display name: "Company name".
* `excludeCategories` (string): Excludes one or more categories (and their respective Link items) from the Search screen. Console display name: "Excludes one or more categories ".
* `excludeLinkItems` (string): Use this parameter to limit the number of Link items that your users can connect to. Provide an array of Link item IDs you want Argyle Link to exclude in the Search screen. Console display name: "Exclude Link items".
* `exitButtonTitle` (string): A value to override the default title of the Done button shown in the Success screen. Console display name: "Title of the Done button".
* `introSearchPlaceholder` (string): Placeholder text in the search box in the Intro screen of Link. Defaults to 'Find and link your employer'. Console display name: "Placeholder text".
* `javascriptWebUrl` (string): Argyle loader javascript web URL. Console display name: "Argyle Loader Javascript Web URL".
* `linkItems` (string): Use this parameter to limit the number of Link items that your users can connect to. Provide an array of Link item IDs you want Argyle Link to display on the Search screen. The order in which you list the IDs will define the order in which they are displayed in the UI. If you provide a single Link item ID, the Search screen will be skipped and the user will be navigated directly to the Link item Login screen. Console display name: "Link items".
* `loadingText` (string): Console display name: "Initialization loading text".
* `nextEvent` (string): Console display name: "".
* `pluginKey` (string): Console display name: "Plugin Key".
* `searchScreenSubtitle` (string): The subtitle in the Search screen. Defaults to 'Find your employer, gig platform, or payroll provider.' . Console display name: "Sub-Title in the Search screen".
* `searchScreenTitle` (string): The main title in the Search screen. Defaults to 'Search for your income source'. Console display name: "Title in the Search screen".
* `showBackToSearchButton` (string): If set to false, hides the Return to search button in the success screen. Console display name: "Show Return to search button".
* `showCategories` (string): Show/hide category tabs (e.g. All, Employer, Gig, Payroll). Console display name: "Show category tabs".
* `showCloseButton` (string): Toggles the visibility of the Close button. This flag works only on the web implementation of Argyle Link (and not on the mobile SDKs). Console display name: "Show Close button".
* `userId` (string): Console display name: "User ID".
* `userToken` (string): User tokens are temporary access keys that let you start Argyle Link for an existing user. They are JWT tokens that contain an expiry date you can use to determine if you need to create a new user token. Newly issued tokens expire in 30 days. Console display name: "Existing user token".

* `button` (string): Console display name: "OIDC Login".
* `customAuth` (string): Console display name: "".
* `showPoweredBy` (string): Console display name: "".
* `skipButtonPress` (string): Console display name: "".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connectorAuthid" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connectorAuthid"
  }
  name = "My awesome connectorAuthid"
  property {
    name  = "authType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorauthid_property_auth_type
  }
  property {
    name  = "button"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorauthid_property_button
  }
  property {
    name  = "customAuth"
    type  = "string"
    value = jsonencode({})
  }
  property {
    name  = "showPoweredBy"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorauthid_property_show_powered_by
  }
  property {
    name  = "skipButtonPress"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorauthid_property_skip_button_press
  }
}
```


## AuthenticID

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `authenticIdConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accountAccessKey` (string): Your Account Access Key provided by AuthenticID . Console display name: "Account Access Key".
* `accountCode` (string): Your AuthenticID account code. Console display name: "Account Code".
* `androidSDKLicenseKey` (string): License key is whitelisted for specific package name. Console display name: "Android SDK Licence Key".
* `apiUrl` (string): AuthenticID REST API URL for sandbox/production environments. Console display name: "REST API URL".
* `applicationLandscapeErrorMessage` (string): Default: Application is not supported in landscape mode. Console display name: "Application Landscape Error Message".
* `authenticIdDocumentType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `authenticIdDocumentTypeV2` (string): The type of identity document. Console display name: "Document Type".
* `backCaptureAttempt` (number): This value specifies the number of back capture attempts the user is allowed to use to capture a good image, after this threshold the last image is used. Default: 4. Console display name: "Back Capture Attempt".
* `backCaptureMode` (string): Console display name: "".
* `backDocument` (string): Default: Back of ID. Console display name: "Back Document Text".
* `backImageData` (string): Image of the back side of the identity document, encoded as Base64 data. Console display name: "Back Image".
* `backIsBarcodeDetectedEnable` (string): This flag specifies if the face detection should be enabled when the back image is captured. Console display name: "Back is Barcode Detected".
* `backOverlayColor` (string): This value is used to color the text shown on the back capture screen. The value should be in CSS3 Hex format. Console display name: "Back Overlay Color".
* `backOverlayTextAuto` (string): This message is shown on top of the back capture screen when the backCaptureMode is set to Auto. Console display name: "Back Overlay Text Auto".
* `backOverlayTextManual` (string): This message is shown on top of the back capture screen when the backCaptureMode is set to Manual. Console display name: "Back Overlay Text Manual".
* `backSetManualTimeout` (number): This value specifies after how many seconds to pass before the capture mode is switched from Auto to Manual. Console display name: "Back Set Manual Timeout in Seconds".
* `barcodeDetectedLabel` (string): Default: Barcode Detected. Console display name: "Barcode Detected Label".
* `baseUrl` (string): AuthenticID API URL for sandbox/production environments. Console display name: "Base URL".
* `bodyHeaderText` (string): Console display name: "".
* `buttonAccept` (string): Default: Accept. Console display name: "Consent Accept Button Text".
* `buttonContinue` (string): Default: Continue. Console display name: "Continue Button Text".
* `buttonDecline` (string): Default: Cancel. Console display name: "Consent Decline Button Text".
* `buttonGo` (string): Default: Go. Console display name: "Button Go Text".
* `buttonGotIt` (string): Default: Got it. Console display name: " Got It Button Text".
* `buttonProceed` (string): Default: Proceed. Console display name: "Proceed Button Text".
* `buttonRetake` (string): Default: Retake. Console display name: "Retake Button Text".
* `callPostbackSecurely` (string): If this value is set to true then the results will be returned to the customer using a secure postback call. The postback URL should be passed in the verify request. Console display name: "Call Post Back Securely".
* `cancelChooseDocument` (string): Default: Cancel. Console display name: "Cancel Choose Document Text".
* `captureCriteriaMissedMessage` (string): Default: Image does not meet capture criteria. Console display name: "Capture Criteria Missed Error Message".
* `captureCriteriaMissedTitle` (string): Default: Caution. Console display name: "Capture Criteria Missed Error Title".
* `captureFarSelfieContent` (string): Default: Now take a selfie at a distance. Console display name: "Capture Far Selfie Text".
* `captureLicenseBackContent` (string): Default: <span aria-live='assertive' role='heading' aria-level='1'>Next, capture the back of your driver's license or state ID.</span><ul style='padding-inline-start: 0em; font-size: small; text-align: left; line-height: 1.5em;list-style-position: outside;margin: 0px 1em'> <li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Make sure to place your document on a flat surface</li><li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Avoid glare and shadows</li><li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Hold your device steady and follow the on-screen instructions</li></ul>. Console display name: "Capture License Back Content".

Console display name: "Capture License Front Content".
* `captureNearSelfieContent` (string): Default: Now take a selfie. Console display name: "Capture Near Selfie Text".
* `capturePassportCardBackContent` (string): Default: <span aria-live='assertive' role='heading' aria-level='1'>Next, capture of the back of your passport card.</span><ul style='padding-inline-start: 0em; font-size: small; text-align: left; line-height: 1.5em;list-style-position: outside;margin: 0px 1em'> <li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Make sure to place your document on a flat surface</li><li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Avoid glare and shadows</li><li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Hold your device steady and follow the on-screen instructions</li></ul>. Console display name: "Capture Passport Card Back Content".
* `capturePassportCardFrontContent` (string): Default: <span aria-live='assertive' role='heading' aria-level='1'>To start, capture the front of your passport card.</span><ul style='padding-inline-start: 0em; font-size: small; text-align: left; line-height: 1.5em;list-style-position: outside;margin: 0px 1em'> <li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Make sure to place your document on a flat surface</li><li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Avoid glare and shadows</li><li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Hold your device steady and follow the on-screen instructions</li></ul>. Console display name: "Capture Passport Card Front Content".
* `capturePassportFrontContent` (string): Default: <span aria-live='assertive' role='heading' aria-level='1'>To start, capture the front of your passport.</span><ul style='padding-inline-start: 0em; font-size: small; text-align: left; line-height: 1.5em;list-style-position: outside;margin: 0px 1em'> <li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Make sure to place your passport on a flat surface</li><li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Avoid glare and shadows</li><li style='margin-bottom: .5em;'>Hold steady and follow instructions on the screen</li></ul>. Console display name: "Capture Passport Front Content".
* `channel` (string): Console display name: "".
* `channelResponse` (string): Console display name: "".
* `chooseDocument` (string): Default: Choose your document. Console display name: "Choose Document Text".
* `clientCertificate` (string): Your Client Certificate provided by AuthenticID. Console display name: "Client Certificate".
* `clientKey` (string): Your Client Key provided by AuthenticID. Console display name: "Client Key".
* `consentAgreementStatement` (string): Default: and agree to it. Console display name: "Consent Agree Statement".
* `consentCheckbox` (string): Default: By checking this box, you are indicating that you have read the. Console display name: "Consent Checkbox".
* `consentNotice` (string): Default: By using this application, you consent to the use and collection of your personal information obtained from any ID document, photo/selfie, or related personal document – solely to be utilized for the purposes of validating your identity. Your personal information will not be shared with any other third party or stored beyond the period of time necessary to perform your identity validation and associated potential background checks for the purposes of employment. <br/><br/> During the use of this application you also consent to the capture of your IP address for the purposes of determining your geographic location and the applicable Privacy Laws. Console display name: "Consent Notice".
* `consentNoticeHeading` (string): Default: Consent Screen. Console display name: "Consent Notice Heading".
* `consentNoticeLinkHeading` (string): Default: Terms & Conditions. Console display name: "Consent Notice Link Heading".
* `customColor` (string): This value is used to color all the buttons in the application. The value should in CSS3 Hex format. Console display name: "Custom Color".

* `declineModalConfirmButton` (string): Default: Yes. Console display name: "Consent Decline Modal Confirm Button Text".

* `documentLicense` (string): Default: DRIVER'S LICENSE OR ID CARD. Console display name: "Document License Text".
* `documentPassport` (string): Default: PASSPORT BOOK. Console display name: "Document Passport Text".
* `documentPassportCard` (string): Default: PASSPORT CARD. Console display name: "Document Password Card Text".

* `doneButton` (string): Default: Continue. Console display name: "Done Button Text".
* `donePageTitle` (string): Default: Identity Verified. Console display name: "Done Page Title".
* `email` (string): Email address to which the link is to be sent for ID Verification. (Required if channel is EMAIL). Console display name: "Email".
* `emailContent` (string): This variable provides the email content that will be sent to your customer. Use '%URL%' in your content template as a placeholder for the verification link. Please make sure no new lines characters are in this string. Console display name: "Email Content".
* `emailFrom` (string): Contains the email from which the verification email will be sent to the customer. Console display name: "Email From".
* `emailSubject` (string): Contains the subject line of the email sent to the customer. Please make sure no new lines characters are in this string. Console display name: "Email Subject".
* `enableFarSelfie` (string): Setting this value to true lets the application request for a far selfie to be captured. Default: true. Console display name: "Enable Far Selfie".
* `enableLocationDetection` (string): This value specifies if GPS location should be captured and embedded in the front and back image. Console display name: "Enable Location Detection".
* `enableSelfieCapture` (string): Setting this value to true lets the application request for a near selfie to be captured. Default: true. Console display name: "Enable Selfie Capture".
* `errorHeader` (string): Default: Error. Console display name: "Error Header".
* `errorPageTitle` (string): Default: Error. Console display name: "Error Page Title".
* `faceDetectedLabel` (string): Default: Face Detected. Console display name: "Face Detected Label".
* `fixCameraMessage` (string): Default: Please fix camera permission and try again. Console display name: "Fix Camera Permission Message".
* `fixCameraTitle` (string): Default: No Camera Permission. Console display name: "Fix Camera Permission Title".
* `focusBack` (number): Specifies the back images focus threshold, any image which does not have a focus value greater than this value will be rejected by the application. Default: 30. Console display name: "Focus Back".
* `focusFront` (number): Specifies the front images focus threshold, any image which does not have a focus value greater than this value will be rejected by the application. Default: 30. Console display name: "Focus Front".

* `frontCaptureAttempt` (number): This value specifies the number of front capture attempts the user is allowed to use to capture a good image, after this threshold the last image is used. Default: 4. Console display name: "Front Capture Attempt".
* `frontCaptureMode` (string): Console display name: "".

* `frontImageData` (string): Image of the front side of the identity document, encoded as Base64 data. Console display name: "Front Image".
* `frontOverlayColor` (string): This value is used to color the text shown on the front capture screen. The value should be in CSS3 Hex format. Console display name: "Front Overlay Color".
* `frontOverlayTextAuto` (string): This message is shown on top of the front capture screen when the frontCaptureMode is set to Auto. Console display name: "Front Overlay Text Auto".
* `frontOverlayTextManual` (string): This message is shown on top of the front capture screen when the frontCaptureMode is set to Manual. Console display name: "Front Overlay Text Manual".
* `frontSetManualTimeout` (number): This value specifies after how many seconds to pass before the capture mode is switched from Auto to Manual. Console display name: "Front Set Manual Timeout in Seconds".
* `glareBack` (number): Specifies the front images glare threshold, any image which does not have a glare value less than this value will be rejected by the application. Default: 2.5. Console display name: "Glare Back".
* `glareFront` (number): Specifies the front images glare threshold, any image which does not have a glare value less than this value will be rejected by the application. Default: 2.5. Console display name: "Glare Front".
* `glareLabel` (string): Default: Glare. Console display name: "Glare Label".
* `homeScreen` (string): This value is used to show the background image in the welcome and consent screen. The value in this field should be a Base64 encoded image file. Console display name: "Home Screen (Base64 image)".
* `iOSSDKLicenseKey` (string): License key is whitelisted for specific bundle id. Console display name: "iOS SDK Licence Key".
* `identityVerification` (string): Default: Identity Verification. Console display name: "Identity Verification Text".

* `internalError` (string): Default: Something went wrong. Please reload the page and try again. Console display name: "Internal Error Text".

* `livenessSelfie` (string): When selected, the selfie image is used to fulfill the "liveness" check instead of the regular selfie image. Console display name: "Use Selfie for Liveness Check".
* `logo` (string): This value is used to show the logo at the welcome screen. The value in this field should be Base64 encoded image file. Console display name: "Logo (Base64 image)".
* `mailHost` (string): Contains the email server hostname. Console display name: "Mail Host".
* `mailPassword` (string): Contains the email server login password. Console display name: "Mail Password".
* `mailPort` (string): Contains the email server port number. Console display name: "Mail Port".
* `mailSmtpAuth` (string): If true, attempt to authenticate the user using the AUTH command. Defaults to false. Console display name: "Mail SMTP Auth".
* `mailSmtpStarttlsEnable` (string): If true, enables the use of the STARTTLS command. Console display name: "Mail SMTP Start TLS Enable".
* `mailUsername` (string): Contains the email server login username. Console display name: "Mail Username".
* `nextEvent` (string): Console display name: "".
* `noTokenFound` (string): Default: Verification request does not exist. Console display name: "No Token Found Error Text".
* `okButton` (string): Default: OK. Console display name: "Fix Camera Permission Ok button Text".
* `passphrase` (string): Your Certificate Passphrase provided by AuthenticID. Console display name: "Certificate Passphrase".
* `phone` (string): Phone number to which the link is to be sent for ID Verification. (Required if channel is PHONE). Console display name: "Phone Number".

Console display name: "Preview License Back Content".

Console display name: "Preview License Front Content".

Console display name: "Preview Passport Card Front Content".

Console display name: "Preview Passport Front Content".
* `processingSubtitle` (string): Default: Processing your information. Console display name: "Processing Subtitle".
* `processingTitle` (string): Default: Processing Result. Console display name: "Processing Title".
* `redirectURL` (string): This is the url where the Digital Mobile Application will be redirected once the identity verification is completed. Console display name: "Redirect URL".
* `requestCompleted` (string): Default: Verification request has already been completed. Console display name: "Request Completed Error Text".
* `requestDeclined` (string): Default: Verification request has been declined. Console display name: "Request Declined Error Text".
* `requestExpiryTimeInMin` (number): This value dictates the expiry time of the verify request's token. Default: 4320. Console display name: "Request Expiry Time in Minutes".
* `requestTerminated` (string): Default: Verification request has been cancelled. Console display name: "Request Terminated Error Text".
* `resultPageRescanMessage` (string): Default: We were not able to complete your document scan. Please retake your images. Console display name: "Result Page Rescan Message".
* `resultPageRescanTitle` (string): Default: Rescan Required. Console display name: "Result Page Rescan Title".
* `resultPageSuccessMessage` (string): Default: Thank you for verifying your identity!. Console display name: "Result Page Success Message".
* `resultPageSuccessMessageWithRedirect` (string): Default: Thank you for verifying your identity!<br/>Click the button below to continue. Console display name: "Result Page Success Message with Redirect".
* `retryCount` (string): Number of retries. Console display name: "Retry Count".
* `reviewScreenBack` (string): If this flag is set to true, Back review screen is shown once back image is captured. Default: true. Console display name: "Review Screen Back".
* `reviewScreenFront` (string): If this flag is set to true, Front review screen is shown once front image is captured. Default: true. Console display name: "Review Screen Front".
* `secretToken` (string): Your Secret Token provided by AuthenticID. Console display name: "Secret Token".
* `segmentResultFailed` (string): Default: We had a problem getting results for your verification request. Please refresh the page and try again. Console display name: "Segment Result Failed".
* `selfieCaptureAttempt` (number): This value specifies the number of selfies capture attempts the user can use to capture a good image, after this threshold the last image is used. Default: 4. Console display name: "Selfie Capture Attempt".
* `selfieCaptureMode` (string): Console display name: "".
* `selfieEnableFaceDetection` (string): This flag specifies if the face detection should be enabled when the selfie image is captured. Console display name: "Selfie Enable Face Detection".
* `selfieImageData` (string): Selfie photo of the user, encoded as Base64 data. Console display name: "Selfie Image".
* `selfieOrientationErrorText` (string): This value is used when the mobile device is oriented incorrectly when selfie is being captured. The correct orientation is Portrait. Console display name: "Selfie Orientation Error Text".
* `selfieOverlayColor` (string): This value is used to color the text shown on the selfie capture screen. The value should be in CSS3 Hex format. Console display name: "Selfie Overlay Color".
* `selfieOverlayTextAuto` (string): This message is shown on top of the selfie capture screen when the selfieCaptureMode is set to Auto. Console display name: "Selfie Overlay Text Auto".
* `selfieOverlayTextManual` (string): This message is shown on top of the selfie capture screen when the selfieCaptureMode is set to Manual. Console display name: "Selfie Overlay Text Manual".
* `selfieSetManualTimeout` (number): This value specifies after how many seconds to pass before the capture mode is switched from Auto to Manual. Console display name: "Selfie Set Manual Timeout in Seconds".
* `selfieUploadFailed` (string): Default: We had a problem uploading your selfie. Please try again. Console display name: "Selfie Upload Failed".
* `selfieUseBackCamera` (string): This value specifies if the back camera should be used instead of the front facing camera. Console display name: "Selfie Use Back Camera".
* `showConsent` (string): If this value is set to true then the consent screen will be shown. Console display name: "Show Consent".
* `startButtonText` (string): Default: Let's get started. Console display name: "Start Button Text".
* `step1Content` (string): Default: Capture photos of your ID. Console display name: "Step 1 Content".
* `step1Title` (string): Default: Capture ID. Console display name: "Step 1 Title".
* `step2Content` (string): Default: Take a selfie of your face. Console display name: "Step 2 Content".
* `step2Title` (string): Default: Take Selfie. Console display name: "Step 2 Title".
* `step3Content` (string): Default: Approve and verify. Console display name: "Step 3 Content".
* `step3Title` (string): Default: Submit. Console display name: "Step 3 Title".
* `title` (string): Console display name: "".
* `transactionAttempts` (number): This value specifies the number of transaction a user can attempt before the request is marked as failures. Default: 4. Console display name: "Transaction Attempts".
* `transactionExpiredMessage` (string): Message to display when the transaction has expired. Console display name: "Transaction Expired Message".
* `transactionExpiryTimeInMin` (number): This value dictates the expiry time of the transaction. Default: 60. Console display name: "Transaction Expiry Time in Minutes".
* `transactionID` (string): Transaction ID obtained from Authenticate Document response. Console display name: "Transaction ID".
* `twilioAccountSid` (string): Contains Twilio account accountSid. Console display name: "Twilio Account String Identifier (SID)".
* `twilioAuthToken` (string): Contains Twilio account authToken. Console display name: "Twilio Authorization Token".
* `twilioFromNumber` (string): Contains the phone number from which the SMS will be sent. Console display name: "Twilio From Number".
* `twilioSmsContent` (string): Contains the structure of the SMS message to be sent to the customer. Use '%URL%' in your message as a placeholder for the verification link. Please make sure no new lines characters are in this string. Console display name: "Twilio SMS Content".
* `unknownError` (string): Default: Something went wrong. Please reload the page and try again. Console display name: "Unknown Error".
* `welcomeMessage` (string): Default: As an added layer of security, we need to verify your identity before providing you with any personal information. Console display name: "Welcome Message".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "authenticIdConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "authenticIdConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome authenticIdConnector"
  property {
    name  = "accountAccessKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_account_access_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "accountCode"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_account_code
  }
  property {
    name  = "androidSDKLicenseKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_android_sdk_license_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "apiUrl"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_api_url
  }
  property {
    name  = "applicationLandscapeErrorMessage"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_application_landscape_error_message
  }
  property {
    name  = "authenticIdDocumentType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_authentic_id_document_type
  }
  property {
    name  = "authenticIdDocumentTypeV2"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_authentic_id_document_type_v2
  }
  property {
    name  = "backCaptureAttempt"
    type  = "number"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_back_capture_attempt
  }
  property {
    name  = "backCaptureMode"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_back_capture_mode
  }
  property {
    name  = "backDocument"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_back_document
  }
  property {
    name  = "backImageData"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_back_image_data
  }
  property {
    name  = "backIsBarcodeDetectedEnable"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_back_is_barcode_detected_enable
  }
  property {
    name  = "backOverlayColor"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_back_overlay_color
  }
  property {
    name  = "backOverlayTextAuto"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_back_overlay_text_auto
  }
  property {
    name  = "backOverlayTextManual"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.authenticidconnector_property_back_overlay_text_manual
  }
  property {
```

## Authentication

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `authenticationUseCaseConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accountCreatedCustomTemplateVariant` (string): You can enter a custom template name, or leave blank to use the default template. You can also enter a parameter from a previous connector, or any text. Console display name: "Custom Value".
* `accountCreatedNotificationSettingsLabel` (string): Console display name: "Notification Settings".
* `accountCreatedShowAdvancedFields` (string): Show advance fields. Console display name: "Show advanced fields".
* `accountCreatedTemplateVariables` (string): If Custom variables are defined in the notification body, map them here. Console display name: "Notification Variables".
* `additionalUserProperties` (string): Add other attributes and their values. Console display name: "Other Attributes".
* `agreement` (string): The name of the agreement. Console display name: "Agreement".
* `agreementId` (string): A unique identifier for the agreement the user has to accept. Console display name: "Agreement ID".
* `agreementLabel` (string): Console display name: "Agreement".
* `changePasswordCustomTemplateVariant` (string): You can enter a custom template name, or leave blank to use the default template. You can also enter a parameter from a previous connector, or any text. Console display name: "Custom Value".
* `changePasswordNotificationSettingsLabel` (string): Console display name: "Notification Settings".
* `changePasswordShowAdvancedFields` (string): Show advance fields. Console display name: "Show advanced fields".
* `changePasswordTemplateVariables` (string): If Custom variables are defined in the notification body, map them here. Console display name: "Notification Variables".
* `checkAccountStatusAgreement` (string): The name of the agreement. Console display name: "Agreement".
* `checkAccountStatusAgreementId` (string): A unique identifier for the agreement the user has to accept. Console display name: "Agreement ID".
* `checkAccountVerificationStatus` (string): When enabled, DaVinci checks whether the user has verified their email address. If they haven't, DaVinci sends a verification code to the email address and continues from the Verification Required outcome. Your flow should collect the verification code from the user and verify it. Console display name: "Check Account Verification Status".
* `checkAgreementConsent` (string): When enabled, DaVinci checks whether the user has not consented to the latest version of the selected agreement. If they haven't, the flow continues from the Agreement Required outcome. Your flow should present the agreement and record whether the user accepts or declines it. Console display name: "Check Agreement Consent".
* `currentPassword` (string): The user's current password. Console display name: "Current Password".
* `email` (string): The user's email address, such as "jsmith@example.com". When Require Email Verification is enabled, this field is required. Console display name: "Email".
* `family` (string): The user's family name, such as "Smith". Console display name: "Family Name".
* `given` (string): The user's given name, such as "John". Console display name: "Given Name".
* `labelSendVerificationCode` (string): Console display name: "This capability does not require any additional configuration.".
* `mobilePhone` (string): The user's phone number, such as "+1-555-555-1234". Console display name: "Phone".
* `newPassword` (string): The user's new password. Console display name: "New Password".
* `nextEvent` (string): Console display name: "".
* `notificationSettingsLabel` (string): Console display name: "Notification Settings".
* `password` (string): The user's password to validate. Console display name: "Password".
* `population` (string): The name of the population. Console display name: "Population".
* `populationId` (string): The unique identifier for the population. Console display name: "Population ID".
* `recoveryCode` (string): The code to validate. Console display name: "Recovery Code".
* `requireUserToVerifyEmail` (string): When enabled, the user must verify their account to finish registration. PingOne sends a verification code to the address provided in the Email field. Following this node, prompt the user to enter the verification code. When disabled, the user does not have to verify their email address. Console display name: "Require user to verify their email".
* `resendPasswordRecoveryCode` (string): When enabled, resend password recovery code mode is enabled. Console display name: "Resend Password Recovery Code".
* `sectionLabelAccountVerification` (string): Console display name: "Account Verification".
* `sectionLabelAgreementConsent` (string): Console display name: "Agreement Consent".
* `sectionLabelNotification` (string): Console display name: "Notification Settings".
* `sectionLabelPwd` (string): Console display name: "Password Settings".
* `sectionLabelPwdAuthn` (string): Console display name: "Password Authentication Settings".
* `sectionLabelUserDetails` (string): Console display name: "User Details".
* `showAdvancedFields` (string): Show advance fields. Console display name: "Show advanced fields".
* `templateVariantAccountCreated` (string): The name of a custom notification defined in PingOne. If the form you want is not listed, select Enter Custom Value. Console display name: "Notification Name (Account Created)".
* `templateVariantChangePassword` (string): The name of a custom notification defined in PingOne. If the form you want is not listed, select Enter Custom Value. Console display name: "Notification Name (Change Password)".
* `templateVariantVerificationCode` (string): The name of a custom notification defined in PingOne. If the form you want is not listed, select Enter Custom Value. Console display name: "Notification Name (Verification Code)".
* `userId` (string): ID of the User. Console display name: "User ID".
* `username` (string): The unique identifier for the user. Console display name: "Username".
* `verificationCode` (string): The code emailed to the user to verify their email address. Console display name: "Verification Code".
* `verificationCodeCustomTemplateVariant` (string): You can enter a custom template name, or leave blank to use the default template. You can also enter a parameter from a previous connector, or any text. Console display name: "Custom Value".
* `verificationCodeNotificationSettingsLabel` (string): Console display name: "Notification Settings".
* `verificationCodeShowAdvancedFields` (string): Show advance fields. Console display name: "Show advanced fields".
* `verificationCodeTemplateVariables` (string): If Custom variables are defined in the notification body, map them here. Console display name: "Notification Variables".

## Authomize API

* `authApiKey` (string): Your Authomize API key. Console display name: "API Key".

## Azure AD User Management

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `azureUserManagementConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accountEnabled` (string): When enabled, the new account is enabled and ready to use. Console display name: "Account Enabled".
* `additionalUserProperties` (string): Define additional attributes to add to the user account. Console display name: "Other Attributes".
* `authType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `baseUrl` (string): The Microsoft API URL to target. For a custom value, select Use Custom API URL and enter a value in the Custom API URL field. Console display name: "API URL".
* `bodyData` (string): The body of the API call. Console display name: "Body".
* `city` (string): The user's city, such as "Seattle". Console display name: "City".
* `country` (string): The user's country, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, such as "US". Console display name: "Country".
* `createUserAccountEnabled` (string): When enabled, the new account is enabled and ready to use. Console display name: "Account Enabled".
* `createUserDisplayName` (string): The name to display in the address book for the user. Console display name: "Display Name".
* `createUserMailNickname` (string): The mail alias for the user, such as "jsmith". Console display name: "Mail Nickname".
* `createUserPassword` (string): The user's password. Console display name: "Password".
* `createUserPrincipalName` (string): The user's principal name, such as "jsmith@example.com". Console display name: "Principal Name".
* `customApiUrl` (string): The URL for the Microsoft Graph API, such as "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0". Console display name: "Custom API URL".
* `customAuth` (string): Console display name: "".
* `customQueryParams` (string): Query parameters for the request. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `department` (string): The user's department, such as "Accounting". Console display name: "Department".
* `disabledPlans` (string): The ID of a plan associated with the new license, such as ["11b0131d-43c8-4bbb-b2c8-e80f9a50834a"]. Separate multiple IDs with a comma. Console display name: "Disable Plan".
* `displayName` (string): The name to display in the address book for the user. Console display name: "Display Name".
* `employeeId` (string): The user's employee identifier, such as "A2304884". Maximum length is 16 digits. Console display name: "Employee ID".
* `endpoint` (string): The Microsoft Graph API endpoint, such as "/user". This endpoint is added to the base API URL selected in the connector configuration. Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `forceChangePasswordNextSignIn` (string): When enabled, the user must set a new password the next time they sign on. Console display name: "Force Change Password".
* `forceChangePasswordNextSignInWithMfa` (string): When enabled, the user must authenticate with MFA then set a new password the next time they sign on. Console display name: "Force Change Password with MFA".
* `givenName` (string): The given name (first name) of the user. Console display name: "Given Name".
* `groupId` (string): The id of the group, such as "0b2b7c5b-4eb2-5c7b-a94b-bea34ac31c30". Console display name: "Group".
* `groupUserId` (string): The user's ID such as "144c6d7e-ef33-46b8-847a-7021943e9900". Console display name: "User ID".
* `groups` (string): The group to target. For a dynamic value, select Use Group ID and enter a value in the Use Group ID field. Console display name: "Group".
* `headers` (string): Define additional headers to send to Microsoft Teams. For help, see the API documentation. Console display name: "Additional Headers".
* `mail` (string): The user's SMTP address, such as "jsmith@example.com". Changes to this property will also update the user's proxyAddresses collection to include the value as an SMTP address. Console display name: "Mail".
* `mailNickname` (string): The mail alias for the user, such as "jsmith". Console display name: "Mail Nickname".
* `method` (string): The HTTP method of the API call. Console display name: "HTTP Method".
* `password` (string): The user's password. Console display name: "Password".
* `removeLicenses` (string): The ID for the license that you want to revoke, such as ["bea13e0c-3828-4daa-a392-28af7ff61a0f"]. Separate multiple IDs with a comma. Console display name: "Remove License".
* `securityEnabledOnly` (string): When enabled, the request only lists the user's security groups. Console display name: "Limit to Security Groups".
* `skuId` (string): The SKU ID for the license that you want to grant, such as "45715bb8-13f9-4bf6-927f-ef96c102d394". Console display name: "Add License".
* `state` (string): The user's state or province, such as "WA". Console display name: "State or Province".
* `surname` (string): The user's surname (family name or last name). Console display name: "Surname".
* `userId` (string): The user's principal name, such as "jsmith@example.com" or "144c6d7e-ef33-46b8-847a-7021943e9900". Console display name: "User ID".
* `userPrincipalName` (string): The user's principal name, such as "jsmith@example.com". Console display name: "Principal Name".
* `userQuery` (string): Customize your request with a user filter or query, such as "$select=displayName,givenName,postalCode". See 'User Query' in the Graph API documentation for help. This field is optional. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `users` (string): The user to target. For a dynamic value, select Use User ID and enter a value in the User ID field. Console display name: "User".

```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "azureUserManagementConnector" {

    id = "azureUserManagementConnector"
```

## Babel Street

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `babelStreetConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `address1City` (string): The city or town for the first address. Console display name: "Address 1 - City".
* `address1Country` (string): The country for the first address. Console display name: "Address 1 - Country".
* `address1HouseNo` (string): The house or building number on the street for the first address. Console display name: "Address 1 - House Number".
* `address1PostCode` (string): The postal code or ZIP code for the first address. Console display name: "Address 1 - Postal Code".
* `address1Road` (string): The street name for the first address. Console display name: "Address 1 - Street".
* `address1State` (string): The state, province, or primary administrative region for the first address. Console display name: "Address 1 - State".
* `address1Unit` (string): The unit, apartment, or suite number for the first address. Console display name: "Address 1 - Unit".
* `address2City` (string): The city or town for the second address. Console display name: "Address 2 - City".
* `address2Country` (string): The country for the second address. Console display name: "Address 2 - Country".
* `address2HouseNo` (string): The house or building number on the street for the second address. Console display name: "Address 2 - House Number".
* `address2PostCode` (string): The postal code or ZIP code for the second address. Console display name: "Address 2 - Postal Code".
* `address2Road` (string): The street name for the second address. Console display name: "Address 2 - Street".
* `address2State` (string): The state, province, or primary administrative region for the second address. Console display name: "Address 2 - State".
* `address2Unit` (string): The unit, apartment, or suite number for the second address. Console display name: "Address 2 - Unit".
* `apiKey` (string): API Key from Babel Street tenant. Console display name: "API Key".
* `content` (string): The text sample to be analyzed for language identification. Console display name: "Content".
* `entityType` (string): The type of entity: Person, Location, or Organization. Console display name: "Entity Type".
* `entityTypeName1` (string): The type of the first name. Console display name: "Name 1 - Entity Type".
* `entityTypeName2` (string): The type of the second name. Console display name: "Name 2 - Entity Type".
* `genderName1` (string): The gender associated with the first name. Console display name: "Name 1 - Gender".
* `genderName2` (string): The gender associated with the second name. Console display name: "Name 2 - Gender".
* `languageName1` (string): The language of the first name. Console display name: "Name 1 - Language".
* `languageName2` (string): The language of the second name. Console display name: "Name 2 - Language".
* `name` (string): The name to be transliterated. Console display name: "Name".
* `sourceLanguageOfOrigin` (string): The name's original language. Console display name: "Source Language of Origin".
* `targetLanguage` (string): The language to transliterate the name into. Console display name: "Target Language".
* `textName1` (string): The first name to be compared. Console display name: "Name 1".
* `textName2` (string): The second name to be compared. Console display name: "Name 2".

## Berbix

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorBerbix`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `body` (string): The raw JSON body, such as "{ "Username": "jsmith@example.com", "ProfileId": "00e8a0000024zkjAAA" }". Console display name: "Body".
* `completionEmail` (string): Email address to alert when transaction has been completed This property should only be set if you intend to create a hosted transaction. Do not set this property if you intend to use a Guided SDK. Console display name: "Completion Email".
* `consentsToAutomatedFacialRecognition` (string): Whether the user has given consent to automated facial recognition Only effective if the corresponding customer setting is set. Console display name: "Consents to automated facial recognition".
* `customerUID` (string): Unique identifier for the user. Used for duplicate ID detection. Console display name: "Customer UID".
* `domainName` (string): Provide Berbix domain name. Console display name: "Domain Name".
* `email` (string): Optional email adress to be used for pre-filling the handoff-to-phone screen on desktop. Console display name: "Email".
* `endpoint` (string): Endpoint. Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `headers` (string): Add HTTP headers and provide their values. Console display name: "Headers".
* `idCountry` (string): The 2-letter country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) for the country that has issued the ID. Only pass this property if you intend to upload images through the Berbix API for this Transaction. Do not pass this property if you intend to use a web or mobile Guided SDK for this transaction. This field isn't required, but providing it may improve results. Console display name: "ID Country".
* `idType` (string): The type of the ID to be verified. Use 'P' for a passport, 'DL' for a driver's license, 'PRC' for a permanent resident card, 'PC' for a passport card and 'ID' for other types of ID cards. Only pass this property if you intend to upload images through the Berbix API for this Transaction. Do not pass this property if you intend to use a web or mobile Guided SDK for this transaction. This field isn't required, but providing it may improve results. Console display name: "ID Type".
* `method` (string): The HTTP Method. Console display name: "Method".
* `path` (string): Provide path of the API. Console display name: "Path".
* `phone` (string): Optional phone number to be used for pre-filling the handoff-to-phone screen on desktop. Console display name: "Phone".
* `queryParameters` (string): Add query parameters and provide their values. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `redirectURL` (string): URL to redirect the user to after they complete the transaction. If not specified, the URL specified in the Berbix dashboard will be used instead. This property should only be set if you intend to create a hosted transaction. Do not set this property if you intend to use a Guided SDK. Console display name: "Redirect URL".
* `templateKey` (string): Template to associate with this transaction. Console display name: "Template Key".
* `token` (string): Provide token. Console display name: "Token".
* `username` (string): Provide your Berbix user name. Console display name: "User Name".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connectorBerbix" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connectorBerbix"
  }
  name = "My awesome connectorBerbix"
  property {
    name  = "body"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorberbix_property_body
  }
  property {
    name  = "completionEmail"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorberbix_property_completion_email
  }
  property {
    name  = "consentsToAutomatedFacialRecognition"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorberbix_property_consents_to_automated_facial_recognition
  }

    value = var.connectorberbix_property_customer_uid
  }
  property {
    name  = "domainName"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorberbix_property_domain_name
  }
  property {
    name  = "email"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorberbix_property_email
  }
  property {
```
