```terraform
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_custom_html
  }
  property {
    name  = "customScript"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_custom_script
  }
  property {
    name = "openId"
    type = "string"
    value = jsonencode({
      "properties" : {
        "skRedirectUri" : {
          "type" : "string",
          "displayName" : "Redirect URL",
          "info" : "Enter this in your identity provider configuration to allow it to redirect the browser back to DaVinci. If you use a custom PingOne domain, modify the URL accordingly.",
          "preferredControlType" : "textField",
          "disabled" : true,
          "initializeValue" : "SINGULARKEY_REDIRECT_URI",
          "copyToClip" : true
        },
        "clientId" : {
          "type" : "string",
          "displayName" : "Client ID",
          "placeholder" : "",
          "preferredControlType" : "textField",
          "required" : true,
          "value" : "${var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_client_id}"
        },
        "clientSecret" : {
          "type" : "string",
          "displayName" : "Client Secret",
          "preferredControlType" : "textField",
          "secure" : true,
          "required" : true,
          "value" : "${var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_client_secret}"
        },
        "scope" : {
          "type" : "string",
          "displayName" : "Scope",
          "preferredControlType" : "textField",
          "requiredValue" : "openid",
          "value" : "${var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_client_scope}",
          "required" : true
        },
        "issuerUrl" : {
          "type" : "string",
          "displayName" : "Base URL",
          "preferredControlType" : "textField",
          "value" : "${var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_base_url}",
          "required" : true
        },
        "returnToUrl" : {
          "displayName" : "Application Return To URL",
          "preferredControlType" : "textField",
          "info" : "When using the embedded flow player widget and an IDP/Social Login connector, provide a callback URL to return back to the application.",
          "value" : "${var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_application_callback}"
        }
      }
    })

  property {
    name  = "showPoweredBy"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_show_powered_by
  }
  property {
    name  = "skipButtonPress"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_skip_button_press
  }
  property {
    name  = "widgetLogoUrl"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_widget_logo_url
  }
  property {
    name  = "widgetUrl"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingfederateconnectorv2_property_widget_url
  }
```

## PingFederate Administration

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `_export_body_ExportRequestSigningSettingsSigningKeyPairRef_location` (string): A read-only URL that references the resource. If the resource is not currently URL-accessible, this property will be null. Console display name: "Location".
* `_export_body_ExportRequestSigningSettings_algorithm` (string): The algorithm used to sign messages sent to this partner. The default is SHA1withDSA for DSA certs, SHA256withRSA for RSA certs, and SHA256withECDSA for EC certs. For RSA certs, SHA1withRSA, SHA384withRSA, and SHA512withRSA are also supported. For EC certs, SHA384withECDSA and SHA512withECDSA are also supported. If the connection is WS-Federation with JWT token type, then the possible values are RSA SHA256, RSA SHA384, RSA SHA512, ECDSA SHA256, ECDSA SHA384, ECDSA SHA512. Console display name: "Algorithm".
* `_export_body_ExportRequestSigningSettings_includeCertInSignature` (string): Determines whether the signing certificate is included in the signature &lt;KeyInfo&gt; element. Console display name: "IncludeCertInSignature".
* `_export_body_ExportRequestSigningSettings_includeRawKeyInSignature` (string): Determines whether the &lt;KeyValue&gt; element with the raw public key is included in the signature &lt;KeyInfo&gt; element. Console display name: "IncludeRawKeyInSignature".
* `_export_body_ExportRequest_connectionId` (string): The ID of the connection to export. Console display name: "ConnectionId".
* `_export_body_ExportRequest_connectionType` (string): The type of connection to export. Console display name: "ConnectionType".

If client-certificate authentication is configured for the SOAP channel, the secondary port is required and this must be set to true. Console display name: "UseSecondaryPortForSoap".
* `_export_body_ExportRequest_virtualHostName` (string): The virtual host name to be used as the base url. Console display name: "VirtualHostName".

The default value is 0, which will disable secondary client secret retention. This value will override the Client Secret Retention Period value on the Authorization Server Settings. Console display name: "ClientSecretRetentionPeriod".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_clientSecretRetentionPeriodType` (string): Use OVERRIDE_SERVER_DEFAULT to override the Client Secret Retention Period value on the Authorization Server Settings. SERVER_DEFAULT will default to the Client Secret Retention Period value on the Authorization Server Setting. Defaults to SERVER_DEFAULT. Console display name: "ClientSecretRetentionPeriodType".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_description` (string): A description of what the client application does. This description appears when the user is prompted for authorization. Console display name: "Description".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_deviceFlowSettingType` (string): Allows an administrator to override the Device Authorization Settings set globally for the OAuth AS. Defaults to SERVER_DEFAULT. Console display name: "DeviceFlowSettingType".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_devicePollingIntervalOverride` (string): The amount of time client should wait between polling requests, in seconds. This overrides the &#39;devicePollingInterval&#39; value present in Authorization Server Settings. Console display name: "DevicePollingIntervalOverride".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_enabled` (string): Specifies whether the client is enabled. The default value is true. Console display name: "Enabled".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_exclusiveScopes` (string): The exclusive scopes available for this client. Console display name: "ExclusiveScopes".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_extendedParameters` (string): OAuth Client Metadata can be extended to use custom Client Metadata Parameters. The names of these custom parameters should be defined in /extendedProperties. Console display name: "ExtendedParameters".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_grantTypes` (string): The grant types allowed for this client. The EXTENSION grant type applies to SAML/JWT assertion grants. Console display name: "GrantTypes".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_jwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseModeContentEncryptionAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Encryption [JWE] content-encryption algorithm for the JWT Secured Authorization Response.&lt;br&gt;AES_128_CBC_HMAC_SHA_256 - Composite AES-CBC-128 HMAC-SHA-256&lt;br&gt;AES_192_CBC_HMAC_SHA_384 - Composite AES-CBC-192 HMAC-SHA-384&lt;br&gt;AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_512 - Composite AES-CBC-256 HMAC-SHA-512&lt;br&gt;AES_128_GCM - AES-GCM-128&lt;br&gt;AES_192_GCM - AES-GCM-192&lt;br&gt;AES_256_GCM - AES-GCM-256. Console display name: "JwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseModeContentEncryptionAlgorithm".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_jwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseModeEncryptionAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Encryption [JWE] encryption algorithm used to encrypt the content-encryption key of the JWT Secured Authorization Response.&lt;br&gt;DIR - Direct Encryption with symmetric key&lt;br&gt;A128KW - AES-128 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A192KW - AES-192 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A256KW - AES-256 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A128GCMKW - AES-GCM-128 key encryption&lt;br&gt;A192GCMKW - AES-GCM-192 key encryption&lt;br&gt;A256GCMKW - AES-GCM-256 key encryption&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES - ECDH-ES&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A128KW - ECDH-ES with AES-128 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A192KW - ECDH-ES with AES-192 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A256KW - ECDH-ES with AES-256 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;RSA_OAEP - RSAES OAEP&lt;br&gt;RSA_OAEP_256 - RSAES OAEP using SHA-256 and MGF1 with SHA-256. Console display name: "JwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseModeEncryptionAlgorithm".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_jwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseModeSigningAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Signature [JWS] algorithm required to sign the JWT Secured Authorization Response.&lt;br&gt;HS256 - HMAC using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;HS384 - HMAC using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;HS512 - HMAC using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;RS256 - RSA using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;RS384 - RSA using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;RS512 - RSA using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;ES256 - ECDSA using P256 Curve and SHA-256&lt;br&gt;ES384 - ECDSA using P384 Curve and SHA-384&lt;br&gt;ES512 - ECDSA using P521 Curve and SHA-512&lt;br&gt;PS256 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-256 and MGF1 padding with SHA-256&lt;br&gt;PS384 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-384 and MGF1 padding with SHA-384&lt;br&gt;PS512 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-512 and MGF1 padding with SHA-512&lt;br&gt;A null value will represent the default algorithm which is RS256.&lt;br&gt;RSASSA-PSS is only supported with SafeNet Luna, Thales nCipher or Java 11. Console display name: "JwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseModeSigningAlgorithm".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_logoUrl` (string): The location of the logo used on user-facing OAuth grant authorization and revocation pages. Console display name: "LogoUrl".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_name` (string): A descriptive name for the client instance. This name appears when the user is prompted for authorization. Console display name: "Name".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_pendingAuthorizationTimeoutOverride` (string): The &#39;device_code&#39; and &#39;user_code&#39; timeout, in seconds. This overrides the &#39;pendingAuthorizationTimeout&#39; value present in Authorization Server Settings. Console display name: "PendingAuthorizationTimeoutOverride".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_persistentGrantExpirationTime` (string): The persistent grant expiration time. -1 indicates an indefinite amount of time. Console display name: "PersistentGrantExpirationTime".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_persistentGrantExpirationTimeUnit` (string): The persistent grant expiration time unit. Console display name: "PersistentGrantExpirationTimeUnit".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_persistentGrantExpirationType` (string): Allows an administrator to override the Persistent Grant Lifetime set globally for the OAuth AS. Defaults to SERVER_DEFAULT. Console display name: "PersistentGrantExpirationType".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_persistentGrantIdleTimeout` (string): The persistent grant idle timeout. Console display name: "PersistentGrantIdleTimeout".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_persistentGrantIdleTimeoutTimeUnit` (string): The persistent grant idle timeout time unit. Console display name: "PersistentGrantIdleTimeoutTimeUnit".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_persistentGrantIdleTimeoutType` (string): Allows an administrator to override the Persistent Grant Idle Timeout set globally for the OAuth AS. Defaults to SERVER_DEFAULT. Console display name: "PersistentGrantIdleTimeoutType".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_persistentGrantReuseGrantTypes` (string): The grant types that the OAuth AS can reuse rather than creating a new grant for each request. This value will override the Reuse Existing Persistent Access Grants for Grant Types on the Authorization Server Settings. Only &#39;IMPLICIT&#39; or &#39;AUTHORIZATION_CODE&#39; or &#39;RESOURCE_OWNER_CREDENTIALS&#39; are valid grant types. Console display name: "PersistentGrantReuseGrantTypes".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_persistentGrantReuseType` (string): Allows and administrator to override the Reuse Existing Persistent Access Grants for Grant Types set globally for OAuth AS. Defaults to SERVER_DEFAULT. Console display name: "PersistentGrantReuseType".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_redirectUris` (string): URIs to which the OAuth AS may redirect the resource owner&#39;s user agent after authorization is obtained. A redirection URI is used with the Authorization Code and Implicit grant types. Wildcards are allowed. However, for security reasons, make the URL as restrictive as possible.For example: https://_*.company.com/_* Important: If more than one URI is added or if a single URI uses wildcards, then Authorization Code grant and token requests must contain a specific matching redirect uri parameter. Console display name: "RedirectUris".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_refreshRolling` (string): Use ROLL or DONT_ROLL to override the Roll Refresh Token Values setting on the Authorization Server Settings. SERVER_DEFAULT will default to the Roll Refresh Token Values setting on the Authorization Server Setting screen. Defaults to SERVER_DEFAULT. Console display name: "RefreshRolling".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_refreshTokenRollingGracePeriod` (string): The grace period that a rolled refresh token remains valid in seconds. Console display name: "RefreshTokenRollingGracePeriod".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_refreshTokenRollingGracePeriodType` (string): When specified, it overrides the global Refresh Token Grace Period defined in the Authorization Server Settings. The default value is SERVER_DEFAULT. Console display name: "RefreshTokenRollingGracePeriodType".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_refreshTokenRollingInterval` (string): The minimum interval to roll refresh tokens, in hours. This value will override the Refresh Token Rolling Interval Value on the Authorization Server Settings. Console display name: "RefreshTokenRollingInterval".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_refreshTokenRollingIntervalType` (string): Use OVERRIDE_SERVER_DEFAULT to override the Refresh Token Rolling Interval value on the Authorization Server Settings. SERVER_DEFAULT will default to the Refresh Token Rolling Interval value on the Authorization Server Setting. Defaults to SERVER_DEFAULT. Console display name: "RefreshTokenRollingIntervalType".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_requestObjectSigningAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Signature [JWS] algorithm that must be used to sign the Request Object. All signing algorithms are allowed if value is not present &lt;br&gt;RS256 - RSA using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;RS384 - RSA using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;RS512 - RSA using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;ES256 - ECDSA using P256 Curve and SHA-256&lt;br&gt;ES384 - ECDSA using P384 Curve and SHA-384&lt;br&gt;ES512 - ECDSA using P521 Curve and SHA-512&lt;br&gt;PS256 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-256 and MGF1 padding with SHA-256&lt;br&gt;PS384 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-384 and MGF1 padding with SHA-384&lt;br&gt;PS512 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-512 and MGF1 padding with SHA-512&lt;br&gt;RSASSA-PSS is only supported with SafeNet Luna, Thales nCipher or Java 11. Console display name: "RequestObjectSigningAlgorithm".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_requireJwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseMode` (string): Determines whether JWT Secured authorization response mode is required when initiating an authorization request. The default is false. Console display name: "RequireJwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseMode".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_requireProofKeyForCodeExchange` (string): Determines whether Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE) is required for this client. Console display name: "RequireProofKeyForCodeExchange".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_requirePushedAuthorizationRequests` (string): Determines whether pushed authorization requests are required when initiating an authorization request. The default is false. Console display name: "RequirePushedAuthorizationRequests".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_requireSignedRequests` (string): Determines whether signed requests are required for this client. Console display name: "RequireSignedRequests".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_restrictScopes` (string): Restricts this client&#39;s access to specific scopes. Console display name: "RestrictScopes".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_restrictToDefaultAccessTokenManager` (string): Determines whether the client is restricted to using only its default access token manager. The default is false. Console display name: "RestrictToDefaultAccessTokenManager".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_restrictedResponseTypes` (string): The response types allowed for this client. If omitted all response types are available to the client. Console display name: "RestrictedResponseTypes".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_restrictedScopes` (string): The scopes available for this client. Console display name: "RestrictedScopes".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_tokenIntrospectionContentEncryptionAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Encryption [JWE] content-encryption algorithm for the Token Introspection Response.&lt;br&gt;AES_128_CBC_HMAC_SHA_256 - Composite AES-CBC-128 HMAC-SHA-256&lt;br&gt;AES_192_CBC_HMAC_SHA_384 - Composite AES-CBC-192 HMAC-SHA-384&lt;br&gt;AES_256_CBC_HMAC_SHA_512 - Composite AES-CBC-256 HMAC-SHA-512&lt;br&gt;AES_128_GCM - AES-GCM-128&lt;br&gt;AES_192_GCM - AES-GCM-192&lt;br&gt;AES_256_GCM - AES-GCM-256. Console display name: "TokenIntrospectionContentEncryptionAlgorithm".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_tokenIntrospectionEncryptionAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Encryption [JWE] encryption algorithm used to encrypt the content-encryption key of the Token Introspection Response.&lt;br&gt;DIR - Direct Encryption with symmetric key&lt;br&gt;A128KW - AES-128 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A192KW - AES-192 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A256KW - AES-256 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A128GCMKW - AES-GCM-128 key encryption&lt;br&gt;A192GCMKW - AES-GCM-192 key encryption&lt;br&gt;A256GCMKW - AES-GCM-256 key encryption&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES - ECDH-ES&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A128KW - ECDH-ES with AES-128 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A192KW - ECDH-ES with AES-192 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A256KW - ECDH-ES with AES-256 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;RSA_OAEP - RSAES OAEP&lt;br&gt;RSA_OAEP_256 - RSAES OAEP using SHA-256 and MGF1 with SHA-256. Console display name: "TokenIntrospectionEncryptionAlgorithm".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_tokenIntrospectionSigningAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Signature [JWS] algorithm required to sign the Token Introspection Response.&lt;br&gt;HS256 - HMAC using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;HS384 - HMAC using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;HS512 - HMAC using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;RS256 - RSA using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;RS384 - RSA using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;RS512 - RSA using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;ES256 - ECDSA using P256 Curve and SHA-256&lt;br&gt;ES384 - ECDSA using P384 Curve and SHA-384&lt;br&gt;ES512 - ECDSA using P521 Curve and SHA-512&lt;br&gt;PS256 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-256 and MGF1 padding with SHA-256&lt;br&gt;PS384 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-384 and MGF1 padding with SHA-384&lt;br&gt;PS512 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-512 and MGF1 padding with SHA-512&lt;br&gt;A null value will represent the default algorithm which is RS256.&lt;br&gt;RSASSA-PSS is only supported with SafeNet Luna, Thales nCipher or Java 11. Console display name: "TokenIntrospectionSigningAlgorithm".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_userAuthorizationUrlOverride` (string): The URL used as &#39;verification_url&#39; and &#39;verification_url_complete&#39; values in a Device Authorization request. This property overrides the &#39;userAuthorizationUrl&#39; value present in Authorization Server Settings. Console display name: "UserAuthorizationUrlOverride".
* `createClient_body_GetClient200Response_validateUsingAllEligibleAtms` (string): Validates token using all eligible access token managers for the client. This setting is ignored if &#39;restrictToDefaultAccessTokenManager&#39; is set to true. Console display name: "ValidateUsingAllEligibleAtms".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseAttributeQueryPolicy_encryptNameId` (string): Encrypt the name identifier. Console display name: "EncryptNameId".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseAttributeQueryPolicy_maskAttributeValues` (string): Mask attributes in log files. Console display name: "MaskAttributeValues".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseAttributeQueryPolicy_requireEncryptedAssertion` (string): Require encrypted assertion. Console display name: "RequireEncryptedAssertion".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseAttributeQueryPolicy_requireSignedAssertion` (string): Require signed assertion. Console display name: "RequireSignedAssertion".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseAttributeQueryPolicy_requireSignedResponse` (string): Require signed response. Console display name: "RequireSignedResponse".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseAttributeQueryPolicy_signAttributeQuery` (string): Sign the attribute query. Console display name: "SignAttributeQuery".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseAttributeQuery_nameMappings` (string): The attribute name mappings between the SP and the IdP. Console display name: "NameMappings".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseAttributeQuery_url` (string): The URL at your IdP partner&#39;s site where attribute queries are to be sent. Console display name: "Url".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoArtifact_lifetime` (string): The lifetime of the artifact in seconds. Console display name: "Lifetime".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoArtifact_resolverLocations` (string): Remote party URLs that you will use to resolve/translate the artifact and get the actual protocol message. Console display name: "ResolverLocations".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoArtifact_sourceId` (string): Source ID for SAML1.x connections. Console display name: "SourceId".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoAttributeContract_coreAttributes` (string): A list of read-only assertion attributes that are automatically populated by PingFederate. Console display name: "CoreAttributes".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoAttributeContract_extendedAttributes` (string): A list of additional attributes that are present in the incoming assertion. Console display name: "ExtendedAttributes".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoDecryptionPolicy_assertionEncrypted` (string): Specify whether the incoming SAML assertion is encrypted for an IdP connection. Console display name: "AssertionEncrypted".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoDecryptionPolicy_attributesEncrypted` (string): Specify whether one or more incoming SAML attributes are encrypted for an IdP connection. Console display name: "AttributesEncrypted".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoDecryptionPolicy_sloEncryptSubjectNameID` (string): Encrypt the Subject Name ID in SLO messages to the IdP. Console display name: "SloEncryptSubjectNameID".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoDecryptionPolicy_sloSubjectNameIDEncrypted` (string): Allow encrypted Subject Name ID in SLO messages from the IdP. Console display name: "SloSubjectNameIDEncrypted".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoDecryptionPolicy_subjectNameIdEncrypted` (string): Specify whether the incoming Subject Name ID is encrypted for an IdP connection. Console display name: "SubjectNameIdEncrypted".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoJitProvisioningUserAttributes_attributeContract` (string): A list of user attributes that the IdP sends in the SAML assertion. Console display name: "AttributeContract".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoJitProvisioningUserAttributes_doAttributeQuery` (string): Specify whether to use only attributes from the SAML Assertion or retrieve additional attributes from the IdP. The default is false. Console display name: "DoAttributeQuery".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoJitProvisioningUserRepository_jitRepositoryAttributeMapping` (string): The user repository attribute mapping. Console display name: "JitRepositoryAttributeMapping".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoJitProvisioningUserRepository_type` (string): The data store repository type. Console display name: "Type".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoJitProvisioning_errorHandling` (string): Specify behavior when provisioning request fails. The default is &#39;CONTINUE_SSO&#39;. Console display name: "ErrorHandling".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoJitProvisioning_eventTrigger` (string): Specify when provisioning occurs during assertion processing. The default is &#39;NEW_USER_ONLY&#39;. Console display name: "EventTrigger".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOauthAuthenticationPolicyContractRef_id` (string): The ID of the resource. Console display name: "Id".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOauthAuthenticationPolicyContractRef_location` (string): A read-only URL that references the resource. If the resource is not currently URL-accessible, this property will be null. Console display name: "Location".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_authenticationScheme` (string): The OpenID Connect Authentication Scheme. This is required for Authentication using Code Flow.  Console display name: "AuthenticationScheme".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_authenticationSigningAlgorithm` (string): The authentication signing algorithm for token endpoint PRIVATE_KEY_JWT authentication. Only asymmetric algorithms are allowed. For RSASSA-PSS signing algorithm, PingFederate must be integrated with a hardware security module (HSM) or Java 11. Console display name: "AuthenticationSigningAlgorithm".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_authorizationEndpoint` (string): URL of the OpenID Provider&#39;s OAuth 2.0 Authorization Endpoint. Console display name: "AuthorizationEndpoint".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_enablePKCE` (string): Enable Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE). When enabled, the client sends an SHA-256 code challenge and corresponding code verifier to the OpenID Provider during the authorization code flow. Console display name: "EnablePKCE".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_jwksURL` (string): URL of the OpenID Provider&#39;s JSON Web Key Set [JWK] document. Console display name: "JwksURL".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_loginType` (string): The OpenID Connect login type. These values maps to: &lt;br&gt;  CODE: Authentication using Code Flow &lt;br&gt; POST: Authentication using Form Post &lt;br&gt; POST_AT: Authentication using Form Post with Access Token. Console display name: "LoginType".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_requestParameters` (string): A list of request parameters. Request parameters with same name but different attribute values are treated as a multi-valued request parameter. Console display name: "RequestParameters".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_requestSigningAlgorithm` (string): The request signing algorithm. Required only if you wish to use signed requests. Only asymmetric algorithms are allowed. For RSASSA-PSS signing algorithm, PingFederate must be integrated with a hardware security module (HSM) or Java 11. Console display name: "RequestSigningAlgorithm".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_scopes` (string): Space separated scope values that the OpenID Provider supports. Console display name: "Scopes".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_tokenEndpoint` (string): URL of the OpenID Provider&#39;s OAuth 2.0 Token Endpoint. Console display name: "TokenEndpoint".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoOidcProviderSettings_userInfoEndpoint` (string): URL of the OpenID Provider&#39;s UserInfo Endpoint. Console display name: "UserInfoEndpoint".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoSsoOAuthMapping_attributeContractFulfillment` (string): A list of mappings from attribute names to their fulfillment values. Console display name: "AttributeContractFulfillment".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSsoSsoOAuthMapping_attributeSources` (string): A list of configured data stores to look up attributes from. Console display name: "AttributeSources".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_adapterMappings` (string): A list of adapters that map to incoming assertions. Console display name: "AdapterMappings".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_alwaysSignArtifactResponse` (string): Specify to always sign the SAML ArtifactResponse. Console display name: "AlwaysSignArtifactResponse".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_assertionsSigned` (string): Specify whether the incoming SAML assertions are signed rather than the entire SAML response being signed. Console display name: "AssertionsSigned".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_authenticationPolicyContractMappings` (string): A list of Authentication Policy Contracts that map to incoming assertions. Console display name: "AuthenticationPolicyContractMappings".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_authnContextMappings` (string): A list of authentication context mappings between local and remote values. Applicable for SAML 2.0 and OIDC protocol connections. Console display name: "AuthnContextMappings".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_defaultTargetUrl` (string): The default target URL for this connection. If defined, this overrides the default URL. Console display name: "DefaultTargetUrl".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_enabledProfiles` (string): The profiles that are enabled for browser-based SSO. SAML 2.0 supports all profiles whereas SAML 1.x IdP connections support both IdP and SP (non-standard) initiated SSO. This is required for SAMLx.x Connections.  Console display name: "EnabledProfiles".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_idpIdentityMapping` (string): Defines the process in which users authenticated by the IdP are associated with user accounts local to the SP. Console display name: "IdpIdentityMapping".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_incomingBindings` (string): The SAML bindings that are enabled for browser-based SSO. This is required for SAML 2.0 connections when the enabled profiles contain the SP-initiated SSO profile or either SLO profile. For SAML 1.x based connections, it is not used for SP Connections and it is optional for IdP Connections. Console display name: "IncomingBindings".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_messageCustomizations` (string): The message customizations for browser-based SSO. Depending on server settings, connection type, and protocol this may or may not be supported. Console display name: "MessageCustomizations".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_protocol` (string): The browser-based SSO protocol to use. Console display name: "Protocol".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_signAuthnRequests` (string): Determines whether SAML authentication requests should be signed. Console display name: "SignAuthnRequests".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_sloServiceEndpoints` (string): A list of possible endpoints to send SLO requests and responses. Console display name: "SloServiceEndpoints".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_ssoServiceEndpoints` (string): The IdP SSO endpoints that define where to send your authentication requests. Only required for SP initiated SSO. This is required for SAML x.x and WS-FED Connections. Console display name: "SsoServiceEndpoints".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpBrowserSso_urlWhitelistEntries` (string): For WS-Federation connections, a whitelist of additional allowed domains and paths used to validate wreply for SLO, if enabled. Console display name: "UrlWhitelistEntries".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpOAuthGrantAttributeMappingIdpOAuthAttributeContract_coreAttributes` (string): A list of read-only assertion attributes that are automatically populated by PingFederate. Console display name: "CoreAttributes".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpOAuthGrantAttributeMappingIdpOAuthAttributeContract_extendedAttributes` (string): A list of additional attributes that are present in the incoming assertion. Console display name: "ExtendedAttributes".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseIdpOAuthGrantAttributeMapping_accessTokenManagerMappings` (string): A mapping in a connection that defines how access tokens are created. Console display name: "AccessTokenManagerMappings".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseInboundProvisioningCustomSchema_attributes` (string): Console display name: "Attributes".
* `createConnection1_body_GetConnection1200ResponseInboundProvisioningCustomSchema_namespace` (string): Console display name: "Namespace".

* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseClientAuth_clientCertIssuerDn` (string): Client TLS Certificate Issuer DN. Console display name: "ClientCertIssuerDn".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseClientAuth_clientCertSubjectDn` (string): Client TLS Certificate Subject DN. Console display name: "ClientCertSubjectDn".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseClientAuth_encryptedSecret` (string): For GET requests, this field contains the encrypted client secret, if one exists.  For POST and PUT requests, if you wish to reuse the existing secret, this field should be passed back unchanged. Console display name: "EncryptedSecret".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseClientAuth_enforceReplayPrevention` (string): Enforce replay prevention on JSON Web Tokens. This field is applicable only for Private Key JWT Client Authentication. Console display name: "EnforceReplayPrevention".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseClientAuth_secondarySecrets` (string): The list of secondary client secrets that are temporarily retained. Console display name: "SecondarySecrets".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseClientAuth_secret` (string): Client secret for Basic Authentication.  To update the client secret, specify the plaintext value in this field.  This field will not be populated for GET requests. Console display name: "Secret".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseClientAuth_tokenEndpointAuthSigningAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Signature [JWS] algorithm that must be used to sign the JSON Web Tokens. This field is applicable only for Private Key JWT Client Authentication. All signing algorithms are allowed if value is not present &lt;br&gt;RS256 - RSA using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;RS384 - RSA using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;RS512 - RSA using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;ES256 - ECDSA using P256 Curve and SHA-256&lt;br&gt;ES384 - ECDSA using P384 Curve and SHA-384&lt;br&gt;ES512 - ECDSA using P521 Curve and SHA-512&lt;br&gt;PS256 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-256 and MGF1 padding with SHA-256&lt;br&gt;PS384 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-384 and MGF1 padding with SHA-384&lt;br&gt;PS512 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-512 and MGF1 padding with SHA-512&lt;br&gt;RSASSA-PSS is only supported with SafeNet Luna, Thales nCipher or Java 11. Console display name: "TokenEndpointAuthSigningAlgorithm".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseClientAuth_type` (string): Client authentication type.&lt;br&gt;The required field for type SECRET is secret.&lt;br&gt;The required fields for type CERTIFICATE are clientCertIssuerDn and clientCertSubjectDn.&lt;br&gt;The required field for type PRIVATE_KEY_JWT is: either jwks or jwksUrl. Console display name: "Type".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseDefaultAccessTokenManagerRef_id` (string): The ID of the resource. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseDefaultAccessTokenManagerRef_location` (string): A read-only URL that references the resource. If the resource is not currently URL-accessible, this property will be null. Console display name: "Location".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseJwksSettings_jwks` (string): JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) document of the OAuth client. Either &#39;jwks&#39; or &#39;jwksUrl&#39; must be provided if private key JWT client authentication or signed requests is enabled.  If the client signs its JWTs using an RSASSA-PSS signing algorithm, PingFederate must either use Java 11 or be integrated with a hardware security module (HSM) to process the digital signatures. Console display name: "Jwks".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseJwksSettings_jwksUrl` (string): JSON Web Key Set (JWKS) URL of the OAuth client. Either &#39;jwks&#39; or &#39;jwksUrl&#39; must be provided if private key JWT client authentication or signed requests is enabled.  If the client signs its JWTs using an RSASSA-PSS signing algorithm, PingFederate must either use Java 11 or be integrated with a hardware security module (HSM) to process the digital signatures. Console display name: "JwksUrl".

* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseOidcPolicyPolicyGroup_location` (string): A read-only URL that references the resource. If the resource is not currently URL-accessible, this property will be null. Console display name: "Location".

* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseOidcPolicy_grantAccessSessionSessionManagementApi` (string): Determines whether this client is allowed to access the Session Management API. Console display name: "GrantAccessSessionSessionManagementApi".

Console display name: "IdTokenContentEncryptionAlgorithm".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseOidcPolicy_idTokenEncryptionAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Encryption [JWE] encryption algorithm used to encrypt the content encryption key for the ID Token.&lt;br&gt;DIR - Direct Encryption with symmetric key&lt;br&gt;A128KW - AES-128 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A192KW - AES-192 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A256KW - AES-256 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A128GCMKW - AES-GCM-128 key encryption&lt;br&gt;A192GCMKW - AES-GCM-192 key encryption&lt;br&gt;A256GCMKW - AES-GCM-256 key encryption&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES - ECDH-ES&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A128KW - ECDH-ES with AES-128 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A192KW - ECDH-ES with AES-192 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A256KW - ECDH-ES with AES-256 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;RSA_OAEP - RSAES OAEP&lt;br&gt;RSA_OAEP_256 - RSAES OAEP using SHA-256 and MGF1 with SHA-256. Console display name: "IdTokenEncryptionAlgorithm".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseOidcPolicy_idTokenSigningAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Signature [JWS] algorithm required for the ID Token.&lt;br&gt;NONE - No signing algorithm&lt;br&gt;HS256 - HMAC using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;HS384 - HMAC using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;HS512 - HMAC using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;RS256 - RSA using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;RS384 - RSA using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;RS512 - RSA using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;ES256 - ECDSA using P256 Curve and SHA-256&lt;br&gt;ES384 - ECDSA using P384 Curve and SHA-384&lt;br&gt;ES512 - ECDSA using P521 Curve and SHA-512&lt;br&gt;PS256 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-256 and MGF1 padding with SHA-256&lt;br&gt;PS384 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-384 and MGF1 padding with SHA-384&lt;br&gt;PS512 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-512 and MGF1 padding with SHA-512&lt;br&gt;A null value will represent the default algorithm which is RS256.&lt;br&gt;RSASSA-PSS is only supported with SafeNet Luna, Thales nCipher or Java 11. Console display name: "IdTokenSigningAlgorithm".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseOidcPolicy_logoutUris` (string): A list of client logout URI&#39;s which will be invoked when a user logs out through one of PingFederate&#39;s SLO endpoints. Console display name: "LogoutUris".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseOidcPolicy_pairwiseIdentifierUserType` (string): Determines whether the subject identifier type is pairwise. Console display name: "PairwiseIdentifierUserType".
* `updateClient_body_GetClient200ResponseOidcPolicy_pingAccessLogoutCapable` (string): Set this value to true if you wish to enable client application logout, and the client is PingAccess, or its logout endpoints follow the PingAccess path convention. * `updateClient_body_GetClient200Response_bypassApprovalPage` (string): Use this setting, for example, when you want to deploy a trusted application and authenticate end users via an IdP adapter or IdP connection. Console display name: "BypassApprovalPage".

All signing algorithms are allowed if value is not present &lt;br&gt;RS256 - RSA using SHA-256&lt;br&gt;RS384 - RSA using SHA-384&lt;br&gt;RS512 - RSA using SHA-512&lt;br&gt;ES256 - ECDSA using P256 Curve and SHA-256&lt;br&gt;ES384 - ECDSA using P384 Curve and SHA-384&lt;br&gt;ES512 - ECDSA using P521 Curve and SHA-512&lt;br&gt;PS256 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-256 and MGF1 padding with SHA-256&lt;br&gt;PS384 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-384 and MGF1 padding with SHA-384&lt;br&gt;PS512 - RSASSA-PSS using SHA-512 and MGF1 padding with SHA-512&lt;br&gt;RSASSA-PSS is only supported with SafeNet Luna, Thales nCipher or Java 11. * `updateClient_body_GetClient200Response_jwtSecuredAuthorizationResponseModeEncryptionAlgorithm` (string): The JSON Web Encryption [JWE] encryption algorithm used to encrypt the content-encryption key of the JWT Secured Authorization Response.&lt;br&gt;DIR - Direct Encryption with symmetric key&lt;br&gt;A128KW - AES-128 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A192KW - AES-192 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A256KW - AES-256 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;A128GCMKW - AES-GCM-128 key encryption&lt;br&gt;A192GCMKW - AES-GCM-192 key encryption&lt;br&gt;A256GCMKW - AES-GCM-256 key encryption&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES - ECDH-ES&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A128KW - ECDH-ES with AES-128 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A192KW - ECDH-ES with AES-192 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;ECDH_ES_A256KW - ECDH-ES with AES-256 Key Wrap&lt;br&gt;RSA_OAEP - RSAES OAEP&lt;br&gt;RSA_OAEP_256 - RSAES OAEP using SHA-256 and MGF1 with SHA-256. * `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenManagers200ResponseItemsInnerAllOfConfiguration_fields` (string): List of configuration fields. Console display name: "Fields".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenManagers200ResponseItemsInnerAllOfConfiguration_tables` (string): List of configuration tables. Console display name: "Tables".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenManagers200ResponseItemsInnerAllOfParentRef_id` (string): The ID of the resource. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenManagers200ResponseItemsInnerAllOfParentRef_location` (string): A read-only URL that references the resource. If the resource is not currently URL-accessible, this property will be null. Console display name: "Location".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenManagers200ResponseItemsInnerAllOfPluginDescriptorRef_id` (string): The ID of the resource. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenManagers200ResponseItemsInnerAllOfPluginDescriptorRef_location` (string): A read-only URL that references the resource. If the resource is not currently URL-accessible, this property will be null. Console display name: "Location".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenProcessor200ResponseAttributeContract_coreAttributes` (string): A list of token processor attributes that correspond to the attributes exposed by the token processor type. Console display name: "CoreAttributes".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenProcessor200ResponseAttributeContract_extendedAttributes` (string): A list of additional attributes that can be returned by the token processor. The extended attributes are only used if the token processor supports them. Console display name: "ExtendedAttributes".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenProcessor200ResponseAttributeContract_inherited` (string): Whether this attribute contract is inherited from its parent instance. If true, the rest of the properties in this model become read-only. The default value is false. Console display name: "Inherited".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_GetTokenProcessor200ResponseAttributeContract_maskOgnlValues` (string): Whether or not all OGNL expressions used to fulfill an outgoing assertion contract should be masked in the logs. Defaults to false. Console display name: "MaskOgnlValues".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_UpdateTokenProcessorRequest_id` (string): The ID of the plugin instance. The ID cannot be modified once the instance is created.&lt;br&gt;Note: Ignored when specifying a connection&#39;s adapter override. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateTokenProcessor_body_UpdateTokenProcessorRequest_name` (string): The plugin instance name. The name cannot be modified once the instance is created.&lt;br&gt;Note: Ignored when specifying a connection&#39;s adapter override. Console display name: "Name".
* `updateTokenProcessor_id` (string): ID of token processor instance. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetMappings200ResponseItemsInnerIssuanceCriteria_conditionalCriteria` (string): A list of conditional issuance criteria where existing attributes must satisfy their conditions against expected values in order for the transaction to continue. Console display name: "ConditionalCriteria".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetMappings200ResponseItemsInnerIssuanceCriteria_expressionCriteria` (string): A list of expression issuance criteria where the OGNL expressions must evaluate to true in order for the transaction to continue. Console display name: "ExpressionCriteria".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetTokenToTokenMappingById200Response_attributeContractFulfillment` (string): A list of mappings from attribute names to their fulfillment values. Console display name: "AttributeContractFulfillment".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetTokenToTokenMappingById200Response_attributeSources` (string): A list of configured data stores to look up attributes from. Console display name: "AttributeSources".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetTokenToTokenMappingById200Response_defaultTargetResource` (string): Default target URL for this Token Processor to Token Generator mapping configuration. Console display name: "DefaultTargetResource".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetTokenToTokenMappingById200Response_id` (string): The id of the Token Processor to Token Generator mapping. This field is read-only and is ignored when passed in with the payload. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetTokenToTokenMappingById200Response_licenseConnectionGroupAssignment` (string): The license connection group. Console display name: "LicenseConnectionGroupAssignment".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetTokenToTokenMappingById200Response_sourceId` (string): The id of the Token Processor. Console display name: "SourceId".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_body_GetTokenToTokenMappingById200Response_targetId` (string): The id of the Token Generator. Console display name: "TargetId".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_id` (string): ID of Token Processor to Token Generator Mapping to update. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateTokenToTokenMappingById_x_bypass_external_validation` (string): External validation will be bypassed when set to true. Default to false. Console display name: "X-BypassExternalValidation".
* `updateUrlMappings1_body_GetUrlMappings1200Response_items` (string): The actual list of SP adapter URL mappings. Console display name: "Items".
* `updateUrlMappings2_body_GetUrlMappings2200Response_items` (string): The actual list of SP connection URL mappings. Console display name: "Items".
* `updateVirtualHostNamesSettings_body_GetVirtualHostNamesSettings200Response_virtualHostNames` (string): List of virtual host names. Console display name: "VirtualHostNames".
* `updateWsTrustStsSettings_body_GetWsTrustStsSettings200Response_basicAuthnEnabled` (string): Require the use of HTTP Basic Authentication to access WS-Trust STS endpoints. Requires users be populated. Console display name: "BasicAuthnEnabled".
* `updateWsTrustStsSettings_body_GetWsTrustStsSettings200Response_clientCertAuthnEnabled` (string): Require the use of Client Cert Authentication to access WS-Trust STS endpoints. Requires either restrictBySubjectDn and/or restrictByIssuerCert be enabled. Console display name: "ClientCertAuthnEnabled".
* `updateWsTrustStsSettings_body_GetWsTrustStsSettings200Response_issuerCerts` (string): List of certificate Issuers that are used to validate certificates for access to the WS-Trust STS endpoints. Required if restrictByIssuerCert is enabled. Console display name: "IssuerCerts".
* `updateWsTrustStsSettings_body_GetWsTrustStsSettings200Response_restrictByIssuerCert` (string): Restrict Access by Issuer Certificate. Ignored if clientCertAuthnEnabled is disabled. Console display name: "RestrictByIssuerCert".
* `updateWsTrustStsSettings_body_GetWsTrustStsSettings200Response_restrictBySubjectDn` (string): Restrict Access by Subject DN. Ignored if clientCertAuthnEnabled is disabled. Console display name: "RestrictBySubjectDn".
* `updateWsTrustStsSettings_body_GetWsTrustStsSettings200Response_subjectDns` (string): List of Subject DNs for certificates that are allowed to authenticate to WS-Trust STS endpoints. Required if restrictBySubjectDn is enabled. Console display name: "SubjectDns".
* `updateWsTrustStsSettings_body_GetWsTrustStsSettings200Response_users` (string): List of users authorized to access WS-Trust STS endpoints when basicAuthnEnabled is enabled. At least one users entry is required if basicAuthnEnabled is enabled. Console display name: "Users".

## PingID

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `pingIdConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `appIconUrl` (string): The URL of the icon that is used for the application the user is trying to access. Console display name: "Application Icon (URL)".
* `appName` (string): The name of the application the user is trying to access. Console display name: "Application Name".
* `authType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `button` (string): Console display name: "Initialize MFA".
* `claimsNameValuePairs` (string): Use this section to add attribute to the request. Console display name: "Attributes".
* `customAuth` (string): Console display name: "".
* `fname` (string): User’s first name. Console display name: "First Name".
* `group` (string): The groups to which the user belongs. Used for applying PingID policies that have been defined. Console display name: "User Groups".
* `lname` (string): User’s last name. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `passwordlessContext` (string): Information returned by the initializePasswordlessAuthentication capability of the connector. Required to continue the passwordless session. Console display name: "Passwordless Context".
* `phone` (string): User’s mobile phone number. Console display name: "Mobile Number".
* `pingidIp` (string): The IP of the device trying to access the application. Used for applying PingID policies that have been defined. Console display name: "IP of accessing device".
* `saasid` (string): The ID of the application the user is trying to access. Used for applying PingID policies that have been defined. Console display name: "Application ID".
* `showPoweredBy` (string): Console display name: "".
* `skipButtonPress` (string): Console display name: "".
* `sub` (string): The username for the user in PingOne. Console display name: "Username".
* `voiceNumber` (string): User's landline number. Console display name: "Landline Number".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "pingIdConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "pingIdConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome pingIdConnector"
  property {
    name  = "appIconUrl"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingidconnector_property_app_icon_url
  }
  property {
    name  = "appName"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingidconnector_property_app_name
  }
  property {
    name  = "authType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingidconnector_property_auth_type
  }
  property {
    name  = "button"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingidconnector_property_button
  }
  property {
    name  = "claimsNameValuePairs"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.pingidconnector_property_claims_name_value_pairs
  }
  property {
    name = "customAuth"
    type = "string"
    value = jsonencode({
      "properties" : {
        "pingIdProperties" : {
          "displayName" : "PingID properties file",
          "preferredControlType" : "secureTextArea",
          "hashedVisibility" : true,
          "required" : true,
```

## PingOne

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `pingOneSSOConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `acccountCreatedTemplateLocale` (string): Add a locale to allow localized notifications for end-users. ISO Language Codes are supported. Console display name: "Notification Locale".
* `acccountCreatedTemplateVariables` (string): If Custom variables are defined in the notification body, map them here. Console display name: "Notification Variables".
* `acceptLanguage` (string): The language in which the agreement is written and indicated by an IEFT BCP 47 language tag, such as "en-US" or "az-Arab". Console display name: "Accept Language".
* `accountCreatedCustomTemplateVariant` (string): You can enter a custom template name, or leave blank to use the default template. You can also enter a parameter from a previous connector, or any text. Console display name: "Custom Value".
* `accountLinkId` (string): ID of the account link. Console display name: "Account link ID".
* `additionalGatewayUserTypeList` (string): Additional gateway and user types to target where users can be found. Console display name: "Additional Gateway and User Types".
* `additionalUserProperties` (string): Add other attributes and their values. Console display name: "Other Attributes".
* `agreement` (string): The name of the agreement. Console display name: "Agreement".
* `agreementId` (string): A unique identifier for the agreement the user has accepted or signed. Console display name: "Agreement ID".
* `agreementPresentationId` (string): The unique identifier for the agreement information to ensure the correct agreement revision and language is being accepted. Console display name: "Agreement Presentation ID".
* `alternativeIdentifier` (string): Enter an Alternative Identifier to look for populations. Console display name: "Alternative Identifier".
* `bypassPolicy` (string): Indicate whether the password policy used to authenticate the user's population should be ignored. Console display name: "Bypass PingOne Password Policy".
* `changePasswordUserCustomTemplateVariant` (string): You can enter a custom template name, or leave blank to use the default template. You can also enter a parameter from a previous connector, or any text. Console display name: "Custom Value".
* `changePasswordUserTemplateLocale` (string): Add a locale to allow localized notifications for end-users. ISO Language Codes are supported. Console display name: "Notification Locale".
* `changePasswordUserTemplateVariables` (string): If Custom variables are defined in the notification body, map them here. Console display name: "Notification Variables".
* `changePasswordUserTemplateVariant` (string): The name of a custom notification defined in PingOne. If the form you want is not listed, select Enter Custom Value. Console display name: "Notification Name (Password Change End User)".
* `clearUserAttributes` (string): Type the PingOne user attributes you want to clear for a user, such as name or primaryPhone, and hit enter after each one. Console display name: "User Attributes to Clear".
* `clearUserAttributesLink` (string): Console display name: "PingOne User Attributes".
* `clientId` (string): The Client ID of your PingOne Worker application. Console display name: "Client ID".
* `clientSecret` (string): The Client Secret of your PingOne Worker application. Console display name: "Client Secret".
* `createUserGroups` (string): JIT Group Provisioning creates/updates external groups based on the provided group list. Console display name: "JIT Group Provisioning".
* `createUserGroupsInput` (string): Enter User Group names in JSON array format. Console display name: "User’s External Group(s)".
* `createUserGroupsLink` (string): Console display name: "Help me decide".
* `createUserGroupsSource` (string): Choose whether external groups are unique to the environment (shared across flows) or unique within a flow. Console display name: "External Group Source ID".
* `createUserIfNotFound` (string): When enabled, DaVinci creates a PingOne user account using attributes from Active Directory. Disable this to support a legacy integration where DaVinci is configured as an External IdP in PingOne. Console display name: "Create PingOne User".
* `currentPassword` (string): The user's current password. Console display name: "Current Password".
* `customDataArray` (string): This input will overwrite the current metadata for the group. Console display name: "Metadata Properties".
* `customDataText` (string): This input will overwrite the current metadata for the group. Console display name: "Metadata Properties".
* `customTemplateVariant` (string): You can enter a custom template name, or leave blank to use the default template. You can also enter a parameter from a previous connector, or any text. Console display name: "Custom Value".
* `description` (string): The description of the group. Console display name: "Group Description".
* `email` (string): Console display name: "Email".
* `enabled` (string): Enable or disable the user's account. Console display name: "Enable User".
* `envId` (string): Your PingOne environment ID. Console display name: "Environment ID".
* `envRegionInfo` (string): If you want to connect with a different PingOne environment, enter the environment and credential information below. Console display name: "The default PingOne environment is configured automatically.".
* `escapeIdentifier` (string): Make usernames with special characters more searchable. Console display name: "Search Special-Character Usernames".
* `externalId` (string): ID of a user at an identity provider. Console display name: "External ID".
* `family` (string): Console display name: "Family Name".
* `filterCondition` (string): Console display name: "Filter Condition".
* `forceChange` (string):  Indicate whether the user must change their password the next time they sign on. Console display name: "Force Change Password".
* `gatewayId` (string): Select the gateway that connects to the Active Directory servers where the users are located. Console display name: "Gateway".
* `gatewayUserTypeList` (string): The gateway and user type to target when validating the user's credentials. These values are based on the gateways configured in your PingOne environment. Console display name: "Gateway User Type List".
* `given` (string): Console display name: "Given Name".
* `group` (string): The name of the group. Console display name: "Group".
* `groupId` (string): The unique identifier for the group. Console display name: "Group ID".
* `groupIds` (string): The IDs of the groups to stream users from. Leave blank to include users from all groups. Console display name: "Group IDs".
* `groupName` (string): The name of the group. Console display name: "Group Name".
* `identifier` (string): Enter the User ID, Username, or Email address of the user that you want to find. Console display name: "Identifier".
* `identityProvider` (string): The name of the PingOne Identity Provider. Console display name: "Identity Provider".
* `identityProviderId` (string): ID of the PingOne Identity Provider. Console display name: "Identity Provider ID".
* `lifecycleStatus` (string): Indicate whether new users must initially verify their identities through email. If they do, they will receive an email containing a verification code when their accounts are created. Console display name: "Lifecycle Status".
* `locale` (string): Console display name: "Locale".
* `matchAttribute` (string): Select the attribute that you want to match against the provided identifier to find a user. Console display name: "PingOne Attribute".
* `matchAttributes` (string): Enter the PingOne attributes you want to use to find a user, such as username, userID, or email. Console display name: "PingOne Attributes".
* `memberGroupRelationship` (string): The output will only include members that are directly assigned to the group, instead of including any members assigned by a filter. Console display name: "Direct Member Relationship".
* `mfaStatus` (string): Console display name: "MFA Status".
* `mobilePhone` (string): Console display name: "Mobile Phone".
* `newPassword` (string): The user's new password. Console display name: "New Password".
* `nextEvent` (string): Console display name: "".
* `nextPageLink` (string): The link object to handle pagination. Console display name: "Next Page Link".
* `overrideUser` (string): User ID is mapped automatically unless you override them here. Console display name: "Override User".
* `password` (string): The user's password to validate. Console display name: "Password".
* `passwordForCreateUser` (string): Console display name: "Password".
* `passwordGateway` (string): The user's password in the PingOne gateway. Console display name: "Password".
* `passwordValue` (string): The user's new password, which can be in a cleartext or pre-encoded format. Console display name: "Password Value".
* `population` (string): The name of the population. Console display name: "Population".
* `populationId` (string): The unique identifier for the population. Console display name: "Population ID".
* `populationIds` (string): The IDs of the populations to stream users from. Leave blank to include users from all populations. Console display name: "Population IDs".
* `preferredLanguage` (string): Console display name: "Preferred Language".
* `primaryPhone` (string): Console display name: "Primary Phone".
* `recoveryCode` (string): The code to validate. Console display name: "Recovery Code".
* `region` (string): The region in which your PingOne environment exists. Console display name: "Region".
* `returnUserPasswordStatus` (string): The output will include a property named 'passwordStatus' which correlates to the user's password state status in PingOne. Console display name: "Return User Password Status".
* `scimFilter` (string): Console display name: "SCIM Filter".
* `setPasswordAdminCustomTemplateVariant` (string): You can enter a custom template name, or leave blank to use the default template. You can also enter a parameter from a previous connector, or any text. Console display name: "Custom Value".
* `setPasswordAdminTemplateLocale` (string): Add a locale to allow localized notifications for end-users. ISO Language Codes are supported. Console display name: "Notification Locale".
* `setPasswordAdminTemplateVariables` (string): If Custom variables are defined in the notification body, map them here. Console display name: "Notification Variables".
* `setPasswordAdminTemplateVariant` (string): The name of a custom notification defined in PingOne. If the form you want is not listed, select Enter Custom Value. Console display name: "Notification Name (Password Change Admin)".
* `showPoweredBy` (string): Console display name: "".
* `singleFactorSignOnFormId` (string): Select the sign on form for single-factor authentication. Console display name: "Sign On Form".
* `skipButtonPress` (string): Console display name: "".
* `subflow` (string): The subflow to run for each user. Console display name: "Subflow".
* `subflowVersion` (string): The version ID of the subflow to run. Leave blank to use the latest version. Console display name: "Version ID".
* `templateLocale` (string): Add a locale to allow localized notifications for end-users. ISO Language Codes are supported. Console display name: "Notification Locale".
* `templateVariables` (string): If Custom variables are defined in the notification body, map them here. Console display name: "Notification Variables".
* `templateVariant` (string): The name of a custom notification defined in PingOne. If the form you want is not listed, select Enter Custom Value. Console display name: "Notification Name".
* `templateVariantAccountCreated` (string): The name of a custom notification defined in PingOne. If the form you want is not listed, select Enter Custom Value. Console display name: "Notification Name (Account Created)".
* `templateVariantVerificationRequired` (string): The name of a custom notification defined in PingOne. If the form you want is not listed, select Enter Custom Value. Console display name: "Notification Name (Verification Code)".
* `theme` (string): Choose a form theme from the themes configured in PingOne environment or use a Theme ID. If no theme is selected, the default active theme will be displayed. Console display name: "Form Theme".
* `themeId` (string): The ID of the PingOne theme to use when rendering the form, such as “aa4b3e81-cf7e-8685-4b7b-7ec89cfcf7c8”. Console display name: "Theme ID".
* `useCustomDataText` (string): Console display name: "Edit Metadata Properties JSON".
* `useCustomSCIMFilter` (string): Console display name: "Custom SCIM Filter".
* `userFilter` (string): A filter to automatically assign users to the group. Console display name: "Dynamic User Filter".
* `userId` (string): ID of the User. Console display name: "User ID".
* `userIdentifierForFindUser` (string): Enter the identifier, which was captured earlier in the flow, that you want to use to find a user. For example, if the attributes specified are email and username, and the identifier is username, the system will search for users whose email or username match the value captured under username. Console display name: "Identifier".
* `userInactivityDurationDays` (string): Console display name: "User Inactivity Duration (days)".
* `userLocale` (string): The user's location, which determines the language in which the agreement is written and indicated by an IEFT BCP 47 language tag, such as "en-US" or "az-Arab". Console display name: "User Locale".
* `userTypeId` (string): Select the user type through which the users can be found. Console display name: "User Type".
* `username` (string): The unique identifier for the user. Console display name: "Username".
* `usernameGateway` (string): The user's unique identifier in the PingOne gateway. Console display name: "Username".
* `verificationCode` (string): The code emailed to the user to verify their email address. Console display name: "Verification Code".
* `verificationCodeTemplateLocale` (string): Add a locale to allow localized notifications for end-users. ISO Language Codes are supported. Console display name: "Notification Locale".
* `verificationCodeTemplateVariables` (string): If Custom variables are defined in the notification body, map them here. Console display name: "Notification Variables".
* `verificationRequiredCustomTemplateVariant` (string): You can enter a custom template name, or leave blank to use the default template. You can also enter a parameter from a previous connector, or any text. Console display name: "Custom Value".

## PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud Access Request

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `accessRequestConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiRequestType` (string): The type of request. Console display name: "Request Type".
* `applicationIds` (string): Array of application IDs in JSON array format, such as ["1d0e...ca94b","debd…2bcf","11e4…cd95"]. Console display name: "Application IDs".
* `baseURL` (string): The API URL to target. Console display name: "Identity Cloud Base URL".
* `bodyData` (string): The body of the API call. Console display name: "Body".
* `comment` (string): Comment. Console display name: "Comment".
* `customFilter` (string): The Common REST filter query to use, such as "givenName eq 'John' and sn eq 'Doe'
". For help, see the IDM documentation > REST API Reference > Common REST > Query.". Console display name: "Filter".
* `endUserClientId` (string): The Client ID from the end user account. Console display name: "End User Client ID".
* `endUserClientPrivateKey` (string): The Client Private Key from the end user account. Console display name: "End User Client Private Key".
* `endpoint` (string): The Identity Cloud API endpoint. Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `entitlementIds` (string): Array of entitlement IDs in JSON array format, such as ["1d0e...ca94b","debd…2bcf","11e4…cd95"]. Console display name: "Entitlement IDs".
* `expiryDate` (string): The date that the request should expire. Use this when the resource is required before a certain date and the request won’t be relevant after that date. Console display name: "Expiry Date".
* `givenName` (string): The first name of the new user. Console display name: "First Name".
* `headers` (string): Additional headers for the request. Console display name: "Additional Headers".
* `justification` (string): Comment on the reason for requesting access to the selected resources. Console display name: "Justification".
* `mail` (string): The email address of the new user. Console display name: "Email Address".
* `matchAttribute` (string): Select the attribute that contains the user identifier provided in the identifier field. Used to identify the user. Console display name: "Identity Management Attribute".
* `matchAttributes` (string): Select the attribute(s) that contains the user identifier provided in the identifier field. Used to identify the user. Console display name: "Identity Management Attributes".
* `method` (string): The HTTP method of the API call. Console display name: "HTTP Method".
* `password` (string): The password for the new user. Console display name: "Password".
* `phaseName` (string): Phase Name. Console display name: "Phase Name".
* `priority` (string): Select a priority level for the request. Your organization can consider the priority level when reviewing the request. Console display name: "Priority".
* `queryParameters` (string): Define additional query parameters for the request. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `realm` (string): The Realm configured in Identity Cloud. Console display name: "Realm".
* `requestAction` (string): Action for the request. Console display name: "Request Action".
* `requestId` (string): The unique ID of the request, such as "bcac0387-e5ea-4c22-981c-df0ea340f1ee". Console display name: "Request ID".
* `requestType` (string): Select an action for the request. Console display name: "Request Action".
* `roleIds` (string): Array of role IDs in JSON array format, such as ["1d0e...ca94b","debd…2bcf","11e4…cd95"]. Console display name: "Role IDs".
* `serviceAccountId` (string): The account ID for your Identity Cloud service account. You can find this ID under the account settings of your service account. Console display name: "Service Account ID".
* `serviceAccountPrivateKey` (string): The private key for your Identity Cloud service account. You can find this private key under the account settings of your service account. Console display name: "Service Account Private Key".
* `sn` (string): The last name of the new user. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `useCustomFilter` (string): When enabled, you can search for users based on a custom filter instead of an identifier. Console display name: "Custom Filter".
* `userAttributes` (string): Add user attributes and their values. Console display name: "User Attributes".
* `userIdentifier` (string): The unique identifier, such as "jsmith@example.com". This is checked against the selected Identity Management Attribute(s). Console display name: "Identifier".
* `userIds` (string): Array of user IDs in JSON array format, such as ["1d0e...ca94b","debd…2bcf","11e4…cd95"]. Console display name: "User IDs".
* `userName` (string): The username assigned to the new user. Console display name: "Username".

## PingOne Authentication

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `pingOneAuthenticationConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accessTokenClaims` (string): Console display name: "".
* `acrValues` (string): Enter the space-separated list of values to pass context to the IdP via OIDC. Console display name: "ACR Values".
* `additionalProperties` (string): Define any additional information to include in the response. Console display name: "Additional Properties".
* `additionalPropertiesName` (string): The name of the property that contains the information defined in Additional Properties, such as "additionalProperties". Console display name: "Additional Properties Name".
* `application` (string): The PingOne OIDC application to use to create the session in PingOne. For a dynamic value, select Use Application ID and enter a value in the Application ID field. Console display name: "PingOne Application".
* `applicationId` (string): The unique identifier for the application. Console display name: "Application ID".
* `authType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `authenticationContextReference` (string): Select the reference element to pass the context based on your agreement with the SAML IdP. The Requested Authentication Context field must be populated beforehand. Console display name: "Authentication Context Reference".
* `authenticationMethodLastUsedIn` (string): The check only passes if the user signed on within this period of time. Console display name: "Last Sign On Was Within...".
* `authenticationMethods` (string): The authentication method that the user signed on with. For a dynamic value, select Use Custom Authentication Method and enter a value in the Custom Authentication Method field. Console display name: "Authentication Methods".
* `button` (string): Console display name: "Login with IdP".
* `checkSessionAuthenticator` (string): The check only passes if the user signed on with the selected authentication method. For a custom value, enter your authentication method reference value in the field, such as "kba" or "mca". This field does not support multiple values. Console display name: "Valid Authentication Method".
* `customAuthenticationMethods` (string): The authentication method that the user signed on with, such as "pwd". Use the abbreviations from the Authentication Methods list or enter a custom value. Separate multiple values with a space, such as "pwd geo fpt". Console display name: "Custom Authentication Methods".
* `customErrorFlag` (string): When enabled, you can provide detailed error information in the fields below. Console display name: "Custom Error Message".
* `errorCode` (string): Console display name: "".
* `errorDescription` (string): Console display name: "".
* `errorMessage` (string): Returned in error field in query parameter. Console display name: "Error Message".
* `errorReason` (string): Console display name: "".
* `idTokenClaims` (string): Console display name: "".
* `idTokenHint` (string): ID token hint provided by Entra ID for step up authentication. Console display name: "ID Token Hint".
* `identifiedDeviceId` (string): Device ID generated by the device identification service. Console display name: "Universal Device ID".
* `identityProvider` (string): Select an external identity provider from your PingOne environment. Console display name: "PingOne External Identity Provider".
* `identityProviderId` (string): The ID of an external identity provider from your PingOne environment, such as “df417355-adc4-2846-41f1-6f4b0b9bd12c”. Console display name: "PingOne External Identity Provider ID".
* `idleTimeout` (string): The amount of time that the session will remain valid after the user becomes inactive. Console display name: "Idle Timeout".
* `linkWithP1User` (string): When enabled, DaVinci creates or updates a linked PingOne user account using attributes from the external IdP. Console display name: "Link with PingOne User".
* `loginHint` (string): Username to prepopulate at the external IdP. Console display name: "Login Hint".
* `overrideAuthState` (string): User and authentication methods are mapped automatically unless you override them here. Console display name: "Override User and Authentication Methods".
* `policyPurpose` (string): Specify whether this policy is intended for users to authenticate at Microsoft via the OpenID Connect protocol or to fulfill the multi-factor authentication requirement as defined in Entra ID external authentication method. Console display name: "Policy Purpose".
* `population` (string): The PingOne population to use when authenticating the user. Console display name: "PingOne Population".
* `populationId` (string): The ID of the PingOne population to use when authenticating the user, such as “aa4b3e81-cf7e-8685-4b7b-7ec89cfcf7c8”. Console display name: "Population ID".
* `requestedAuthenticationContext` (string): Enter the space-separated list of values to pass context to the IdP via SAML 2.0. Console display name: "Requested Authentication Context".
* `returnUrl` (string): When using the embedded flow player widget and an IdP/Social Login connector, provide a callback URL to return back to the application. Console display name: "Application Return to Url".
* `scopes` (string): The scopes to request for the user, such as "openid email". This field allows you to request a limited subset of the original scopes. You cannot add any scopes that are not part of the original request. Separate multiple scopes with a space. Leave this blank to pass along all of the scopes from the original request. Console display name: "Reduced Scopes".
* `showPoweredBy` (string): Console display name: "".
* `skipButtonPress` (string): Console display name: "".
* `softDelete` (string): When enabled, PingOne signs the user out but does not delete the session. Console display name: "Soft Delete".
* `userCode` (string): The user code provided by the end user. Console display name: "User Code".
* `userId` (string): The user’s PingOne user ID. Console display name: "User ID".
* `widgetScopes` (string): The scopes to request for the user, such as "openid email". Leave this blank to request all scopes configured in the PingOne application, or enter a subset of the application scopes. Separate multiple scopes with a space. Console display name: "Reduced Scopes".
