```terraform
    value = var.sentineloneconnector_property_base_url
  }
  property {
    name  = "serialNumber"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sentineloneconnector_property_serial_number
  }
}
```


## ServiceNow

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `servicenowConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `active` (string): When enabled, this sets the user account to active in ServiceNow. Console display name: "Activate User".
* `adminUsername` (string): Your ServiceNow administrator username. Console display name: "Username".
* `apiUrl` (string): The API URL to target, such as "https://mycompany.service-now.com". Console display name: "API URL".
* `callerId` (string): The ServiceNow system ID of the user with the issue, such as "bdac51a8e4afd91bda9d1018cc4bcbc8". Console display name: "Caller ID".
* `city` (string): The User's city. Console display name: "City".
* `customAttributes` (string): Additional attributes for user creation or modification. Console display name: "Custom Attributes".
* `email` (string): The user's email address. Console display name: "Email".
* `emailOptional` (string): The user's email address. Console display name: "Email".
* `employeeNumber` (string): The User's employee number. Console display name: "Employee Number".
* `firstName` (string): The user's first name. Console display name: "First Name".
* `firstNameOptional` (string): The user's first name. Console display name: "First Name".
* `group` (string): The relevant group. Console display name: "Group".
* `incidentBusinessService` (string): The service associated with the incident. Console display name: "Service".
* `incidentCategory` (string): The incident category. Console display name: "Category".
* `incidentConfigItem` (string): The ServiceNow system ID of the related configuration item, such as "fd91bda9d10bdac51a8e4a18cc4bcbc8". Console display name: "Configuration Item ID".
* `incidentContactType` (string): The channel (source) where the incident took place. Console display name: "Channel".
* `incidentDescription` (string): A complete description of the incident. Console display name: "Description".
* `incidentId` (string): The incident’s ServiceNow system ID, such as "c4bcbc8bdac51a8e4afd91bda9d1018c". Console display name: "Incident ID".
* `incidentImpact` (string): The level of impact for the incident. Console display name: "Impact".
* `incidentNumber` (string): The incident number, such as "INC0010077". Console display name: "Incident Number".
* `incidentShortDescription` (string): A brief description of the incident. Console display name: "Short Description".
* `incidentState` (string): The status of the incident. Console display name: "Status".
* `incidentSubcategory` (string): The incident subcategory. Console display name: "Subcategory".
* `incidentSwitcher` (string): Determines whether to get incident information based on an incident number or by ServiceNow system ID. Console display name: "Incident Search Attribute".
* `incidentUrgency` (string): The level of urgency for the incident. Console display name: "Urgency".
* `lastName` (string): The user's last name. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `lastNameOptional` (string): The user's last name. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `lockedOut` (string): When enabled, the user is locked out of ServiceNow. Console display name: "Lock User Out".
* `middleName` (string): The user's middle name. Console display name: "Middle Name".
* `middleNameOptional` (string): The user's middle name. Console display name: "Middle Name".
* `password` (string): Your ServiceNow administrator password. Console display name: "Password".
* `phone` (string): The user's phone number. Console display name: "Phone".
* `queryParams` (string): Define additional query parameters to send to ServiceNow. For help, see the ServiceNow user table documentation. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `readIncidentId` (string): The incident’s ServiceNow system ID, such as "c4bcbc8bdac51a8e4afd91bda9d1018c". Console display name: "Incident ID".
* `sysParmLimit` (string): The number of results to return from the search. Console display name: "Number of Results".
* `userId` (string): The user's ServiceNow system ID, such as "bdac51a8e4afd91bda9d1018cc4bcbc8". Console display name: "User System ID".
* `username` (string): The unique ID of the user. Console display name: "Username".
* `usernameOptional` (string): The unique ID of the user. Console display name: "Username".


Example:

```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "servicenowConnector" {
```

## Shopify Connector

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorShopify`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accessToken` (string): Your store's unique Admin API Access Token that goes into the X-Shopify-Access-Token property. Required scopes when generating Admin API Access Token: 'read_customers' and 'write_customers'. Note any Custom Shopify API calls you intend to use with this connector via Make Custom API Call capability, will have to be added as well. Console display name: "Admin API Access Token".
* `address` (string): Customer's street address. Console display name: "Street Address".
* `address2` (string): Second field for customer's street address. Console display name: "Address2 field".
* `apiVersion` (string): The Shopify version name ( ex. 2022-04 ). Console display name: "API Version Name".
* `body` (string): The raw JSON body, such as "{ "Username": "jsmith@example.com", "ProfileId": "00e8a0000024zkjAAA" }". Console display name: "Body".
* `city` (string): The city of the customer's address. Console display name: "City".
* `country` (string): The country of the customer's address. Console display name: "Country".
* `customerID` (string): The unique customer id number that Shopify assigns to a customer. Console display name: "Customer ID Number".
* `email` (string): Email of the customer. Console display name: "Email".
* `endpoint` (string): The Shopify API endpoint, such as "/admin/api/{apiVersion}/customers.json". Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `fname` (string): The first name of the customer. Console display name: "First Name".
* `headers` (string): Add HTTP headers and provide their values. Console display name: "Headers".
* `listonlyCreatedAfter` (string): Show customers created after a specified date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Console display name: "Created After (list only)".
* `listonlyCreatedBefore` (string): Show customers created before a specified date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Console display name: "Created Before (list only)".
* `listonlyLimit` (string): The maximum number of customers to show (<=250 , default=50). Console display name: "Limit for # results to show (list only)".
* `listonlyUpdatedAfter` (string): Show customers last updated after a specified date. (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00). Console display name: "Updated After (list only)".
* `listonlyUpdatedBefore` (string): Show customers last updated before a specified date. (format: 2014-04-25T16:15:47-04:00). Console display name: "Updated Before (list only)".
* `lname` (string): The last name of the customer. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `method` (string): The HTTP Method. Console display name: "Method".
* `multipassSecret` (string): Shopify Multipass Secret. Console display name: "Multipass Secret".
* `multipassStoreDomain` (string): Shopify Multipass Store Domain (yourstorename.myshopify.com). Console display name: "Multipass Store Domain".
* `phone` (string): The phone number of the customer. Console display name: "Phone Number".
* `province` (string): The province of the customer's address. Console display name: "Province".
* `queryParameters` (string): Add query parameters and provide their values. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `remoteIp` (string): Customer's remote ip. Console display name: "Remote IP".
* `returnTo` (string): Return to URL. Console display name: "Return To URL".
* `verified` (string): If set to True, assumes the email has been verified. If set to False, will send the customer a verification email. Console display name: "Verified Email".
* `yourStoreName` (string): The name of your store as Shopify identifies you ( first text that comes after HTTPS:// ). Console display name: "Store Name".
* `zip` (string): The zip code or postal code of the customer's address. Console display name: "Zip/Postal code".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connectorShopify" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connectorShopify"
  }
  name = "My awesome connectorShopify"
  property {
    name  = "accessToken"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorshopify_property_access_token
```

## Sift

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `siftConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `abuseTypes` (string): The type of abuse for which you want to send a label. Console display name: "Abuse Types".
* `acceptLanguage` (string): The language(s) that the client is requesting the site content be delivered in. Use ISO-3166 format for country codes. Examples: 'en', 'en-us, de', 'fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8, de;q=0.7, *;q=0.5', etc. Console display name: "Accept Language".
* `accountId` (string): Your Sift Account ID, which can be found in the Sift Console under the Developer Tab. Console display name: "Account ID".
* `address1Billing` (string): Billing address line 1 of end user. Console display name: "Address 1 - Billing".
* `address1Shipping` (string): Shipping address line 1 of end user. Console display name: "Address 1 - Shipping".
* `address2Billing` (string): Billing address line 2 of end user. Console display name: "Address 2 - Billing".
* `address2Shipping` (string): Shipping address line 2 of end user. Console display name: "Address 2 - Shipping".
* `analyst` (string): Analyst who applied the Decision, only required when source is set to Manual Review. Does not need to be an email, can be any analyst identifier. Console display name: "Analyst".
* `apiKey` (string): API Key from Sift Tenant. Console display name: "Sift API Key".
* `body` (string): This property needs to be a properly formatted JSON value. It can contain DaVinci parameters, which will be replaced at runtime. If you are using DaVinci parameters that are of type 'string', you will need to put string quotes around it. Console display name: "HTTP Body (JSON)".
* `changedPassword` (string): Track password changes via Update Password. If the user changed their password, set this field and mark as true. Additionally, Sift's recommended approach is to send the Update Password reserved event. Console display name: "Changed Password".
* `cityBilling` (string): Billing city of end user. Console display name: "City - Billing".
* `cityShipping` (string): Shipping city of end user. Console display name: "City - Shipping".
* `contentLanguage` (string): The language(s) of the user that the delivered site content is intended for. Use ISO-3166 format for country codes. Examples: 'en', 'en-us, de', 'fr-CH, fr;q=0.9, en;q=0.8, de;q=0.7, *;q=0.5', etc. Console display name: "Content Language".
* `countryBilling` (string): Billing country of end user. Console display name: "Country - Billing".
* `countryShipping` (string): Shipping country of end user. Console display name: "Country - Shipping".
* `decisionId` (string): The unique identifier of the Decision to be applied to an entity. Console display name: "Decision ID".
* `decisionType` (string): The Apply Decisions API allows you to apply Decisions to users or sessions. Console display name: "Decision Type".
* `description` (string): A description of the Decision that will be applied. Console display name: "Description".
* `email` (string): Email of the user logging in. Console display name: "Email".
* `endpoint` (string): The Sift API endpoint after https://api.sift.com/v205/, such as "events?return_workflow_status=true". Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `failureReason` (string): Capture the reason for the failure of the login. Console display name: "Failure Reason".
* `fullName` (string): The full name of the user. Console display name: "Full name".
* `fullNameBilling` (string): The full name of the user associated with the billing address. Console display name: "Full name - Billing".
* `fullNameShipping` (string): The full name of the user associated with the shipping address. Console display name: "Full name - Shipping".
* `headers` (string): Add HTTP headers and provide their values. Console display name: "Headers".
* `ipAddress` (string): IP address of the user that is logging in. Console display name: "IP Address".
* `loginStatus` (string): Use Login Status to represent the success or failure of the login attempt. Console display name: "Login Status".
* `method` (string): The HTTP Method. Console display name: "Method".
* `phoneNumber` (string): Phone number of the user. This phone number will be used to send One-Time Password (OTP) when required. The phone number should be in E.164 format including + and a country code. Console display name: "Phone Number".
* `phoneNumberBilling` (string): Phone Number associated with the billing address of the user. Console display name: "Phone Number - Billing".
* `phoneNumberPrimary` (string): Primary phone number of the user. Console display name: " Primary Phone Number".
* `phoneNumberShipping` (string): Phone Number associated with the shipping address of the user. Console display name: "Phone Number - Shipping".
* `queryParameters` (string): Add query parameters and provide their values. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `reason` (string): The reason the password was updated or an update was attempted. Console display name: "Reason".
* `regionBilling` (string): Billing region of end user. Console display name: "Region - Billing".
* `regionShipping` (string): Shipping region of end user. Console display name: "Region - Shipping".
* `returnScore` (string): Return scores back when sending an event. Cannot be set to On if Workflow Status is set to On. Console display name: "Return Score".
* `scorePercentiles` (string): Include scores percentiles when sending an event - this feature must be enabled as part of your plan. Console display name: "Score Percentiles".
* `sessionId` (string): The user's current session ID, used to tie a user's action before and after log in or account creation. NOTE: this is required if no $user_id is provided. Console display name: "Session ID".
* `sessionIdDecision` (string): The user's current session ID, used to tie a user's action before and after log in or account creation. Console display name: "Session ID".
* `sessionIdOptional` (string): The user's current session ID, used to tie a user's action before and after log in or account creation. Console display name: "Session ID".
* `source` (string): The source of this Decision. Console display name: "Source".
* `status` (string): The status of the password update or verification event. Console display name: "Status".
* `userAgent` (string): The user agent of the browser that is interacting with your website. Console display name: "User Agent".
* `userId` (string): The user's account ID according to your systems. Console display name: "User ID".
* `username` (string): The username entered at the login prompt. Console display name: "Username".
* `verificationType` (string): The type of verification being performed. Console display name: "Verification Type".
* `verifiedReason` (string): The trigger for the verification. Console display name: "Reason".
* `verifiedValue` (string): The phone number (e.g. 14155551212, 442072193000), email address (e.g. bob@example.com) or the question (e.g., 'what is your mother's maiden name?') used for verification. This value should be passed when the Veification Type is set to SMS, Phone Call, Email or Shared Knowledge. Console display name: "Verified Value".
* `workflowStatus` (string): Receive the Workflow Decision synchronously when sending an event to Sift. Note that user IDs are case sensitive. Must be set to 'False' if Return Score is set to 'True'. Console display name: "Workflow Status".
* `zipcodeBilling` (string): Billing Zipcode of end user. Console display name: "Zipcode - Billing".
* `zipcodeShipping` (string): Shipping zipcode of end user. Console display name: "Zipcode - Shipping".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "siftConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "siftConnector"
  }

    value = var.siftconnector_property_abuse_types
```

## Silverfort

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `silverfortConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `userParameter` (string): Choose the entity type to interact with: User Principal Name, Distinguished Name, or Resource Name. Console display name: "User Parameter".
* `validFor` (string): Length of time severity is valid for (in hours). Use integers, example: 2. Console display name: "Valid For".

## Sinch

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `sinchConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `acceptLanguage` (string): Language of SMS sent, if using Sinch provided templates will be chosen based on Accept-Language header. Examples include, but are not limited to pl-PL, no-NO, en-US. Console display name: "Language".
* `applicationKey` (string): Verification Application Key from your Sinch Account. Console display name: "Sinch Application Key".
* `code` (string): Verification Code sent to end user via SMS or Phone Call. Console display name: "Code".
* `codeType` (string): Choose from Numeric, Alpha, Alphanumeric. Default is Numeric. Console display name: "Code Type".
* `expiry` (string): Time after which verification process will be considered expired and reporting will not longer be possible. Accepts time in format HH:MM:SS. Console display name: "Expiry".
* `id` (string): Verification ID is returned as part of the output from the Send Verification Code capability (id). Console display name: "Verification ID".
* `phoneNumber` (string): Phone number of the end user. Console display name: "Phone Number".
* `secretKey` (string): Verification Secret Key from your Sinch Account. Console display name: "Sinch Secret Key".
* `verificationType` (string): Choose SMS or Phone Call to send a verification code. Console display name: "Method".

```terraform
  }

    name  = "acceptLanguage"

    value = var.sinchconnector_property_accept_language
  }
  property {
    name  = "applicationKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sinchconnector_property_application_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "code"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sinchconnector_property_code
  }
  property {
    name  = "codeType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sinchconnector_property_code_type
  }
  property {
    name  = "expiry"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sinchconnector_property_expiry
  }
  property {
    name  = "id"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sinchconnector_property_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "phoneNumber"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sinchconnector_property_phone_number
  }
  property {
    name  = "secretKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sinchconnector_property_secret_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "verificationType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.sinchconnector_property_verification_type
  }
}
```

* `recipientCountry` (string): Console display name: "Recipient Country".
* `screen0Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `screen1Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `screen2Config` (string): Console display name: "".

## Socure RiskOS

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `socureriskosConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiKey` (string): Your Socure RiskOS API key. The connector sends it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. Console display name: "API Key".
* `attachments` (string): JSON array of attachment objects, each with file_name (string) and file_data (base64-encoded string). Console display name: "Attachments".
* `baseUrl` (string): The RiskOS API base URL (e.g. https://riskos.socure.com or https://riskos.sandbox.socure.com). Do not include a trailing slash. Console display name: "Base URL".
* `customer_metadata` (string): Optional opaque JSON object (max 200 chars serialized) echoed back unchanged in the response. Do not include PII or secrets. Console display name: "Customer Metadata".
* `data` (string): Primary evaluation payload as a JSON object. Structure is determined by the selected workflow type. Console display name: "Data".
* `decision` (string): New decision to apply. One of: ACCEPT, REJECT, REVIEW, RESUBMIT, or CANCEL. Console display name: "Decision".
* `eval_id` (string): The system-generated unique evaluation ID returned from the Run Risk Evaluation step. Console display name: "Evaluation ID".
* `fraud_label` (string): Fraud classification. Must be either "fraud" or "non-fraud". Console display name: "Fraud Label".
* `fraud_type` (string): Optional fraud typology or category describing the nature of the fraud (e.g. identity_theft). Console display name: "Fraud Type".
* `id` (string): Customer-defined unique identifier for the request. Must be distinct per evaluation to avoid reprocessing. Console display name: "Request ID".
* `notes` (string): Contextual notes to attach to the evaluation. Console display name: "Notes".
* `queue` (string): Review queue to assign the evaluation to. Console display name: "Queue".
* `recorded_at` (string): Date the fraud was observed or confirmed in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today if omitted. Console display name: "Recorded At".
* `recorded_by` (string): Name or identifier of the person recording the fraud. Defaults to the authenticated user if omitted. Console display name: "Recorded By".
* `status` (string): New evaluation status. One of: OPEN, CLOSED, or ON_HOLD. Console display name: "Status".
* `sub_status` (string): Additional granular status detail for the evaluation. Console display name: "Sub Status".
* `tags` (string): Comma-separated list of tags to apply to the evaluation. Console display name: "Tags".
* `timestamp` (string): Evaluation initiation time in ISO 8601/RFC 3339 format (e.g. 2024-05-01T14:30:00Z). Defaults to the current time if not provided. Console display name: "Timestamp".
* `workflow` (string): Environment-specific workflow identifier from the RiskOS Dashboard Developer Workbench. Console display name: "Workflow".

## String

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `stringsConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `concatenateDelimiter` (string): The optional string to include between each concatenated value, such as ", " or "-". Console display name: "Delimiter".
* `concatenateInput` (string): The string to process. Enter a string or select a string value from your flow. Console display name: "Input String".
* `dataTypeTo` (string): Select the data type to change the input value to. Console display name: "Change to".
* `decodeMethod` (string): The decoding format applied to the input string. Console display name: "String Decode Method".
* `delimiter` (string): The unique character used to separate strings. Console display name: "Delimiter".
* `encodeMethod` (string): The encoding format applied to the input string. Console display name: "String Encode Method".
* `finalDelimiter` (string): When enabled, the delimiter is also included at the end of the concatenated string. Console display name: "Include Final Delimiter".
* `finder` (string): The substring to process. Enter a string or select a string value from your flow. Console display name: "Find Substring".
* `inputValue` (string): The value to process. Enter a string or select a string value from your flow. Console display name: "Input String".
* `isAlphaNumeric` (string): By default, generated strings are a mix of uppercase and lowercase letters. When enabled, the string also includes numbers. Console display name: "Include Numbers".
* `isRegex` (string): By default, the value in the Search field is used for simple matching. When enabled, the value in the Search field must be formatted as a regular expression such as "/<expression>/g". Console display name: "Search Using Regex?".
* `length` (number): Enter the number of characters you want in the string, such as "15". Console display name: "String Length".
* `newToken` (string): When a match is found, the text identified by the Search field is replaced with this string. Console display name: "New String Value".
* `oldToken` (string): The text to search for in the original string value. For simple matching, enter literal text, such as "test". For more complex matching, enter a valid regular expression and enable Search Using Regex. For example, entering "/te[xs]t/g" matches both "test" and "text". Console display name: "Search".
* `originalValue` (string): The string to process. Enter a string or select a string value from your flow. Console display name: "Input Value".
* `replaceMode` (string): Determines whether the first match or all matches are replaced with the new value. Console display name: "Replace Mode".
* `shouldTrim` (string): When enabled, removes any white space at the beginning or end of the input string. Console display name: "Trim White Space".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "stringsConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "stringsConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome stringsConnector"
  property {
    name  = "concatenateDelimiter"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.stringsconnector_property_concatenate_delimiter
  }
  property {
    name  = "concatenateInput"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.stringsconnector_property_concatenate_input
  }
  property {
    name  = "dataTypeTo"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.stringsconnector_property_data_type_to
  }
  property {
    name  = "decodeMethod"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.stringsconnector_property_decode_method
  }
  property {
```

## TMT Analysis

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `tmtConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiKey` (string): API Key for TMT Analysis. Console display name: "API Key".
* `apiSecret` (string): API Secret for TMT Analysis. Console display name: "API Secret".
* `apiUrl` (string): The Base API URL for TMT Analysis. Console display name: "Base URL".
* `city` (string): Value that will be matched against the city on file, generating a city name matching score where available, otherwise having a weight in the overall address matching score. Console display name: "City".
* `country` (string): Value that will be matched against the country on file, generating a country name matching score where available, otherwise having a weight in the overall address matching score. Console display name: "Country".
* `dataPoints` (string): Console display name: "".
* `day` (number): Day of birth. This parameter will be used with month and year to generate an overall matching score for DOB. Console display name: "DOB (Day)".
* `email` (string): Value that will be matched against the email on file,. Console display name: "Email".
* `first_name` (string): Value that will be matched against the first name on file, generating the matching score in the response. Console display name: "First Name".
* `last_name` (string): Value that will be matched against the last name on file, generating the matching score in the response. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `middle_name` (string): If middle name matching is available, the middle name matching score will be returned in the response. If middle name matching is not available, the submitted middle name will be matched with the submitted first_name and an overall first name match score will be returned. Console display name: "Middle Name".
* `month` (number): Month of birth. This parameter will be used with day and year to generate an overall matching score for DOB. Console display name: "DOB (Month)".
* `phoneNumber` (string): Phone Number that we want to extract information for. Console display name: "Phone Number".
* `postcode` (string): Value that will be matched against the postal code on file, generating a postal code matching score where available, otherwise having a weight in the overall address matching score. Console display name: "Post Code".
* `province` (string): Value that will be matched against the province on file, generating a province name matching score where available, otherwise having a weight in the overall address matching score. Console display name: "Province".
* `street` (string): Value that will be matched against the street name on file, generating a street name matching score where available, otherwise having a weight in the overall address matching score. Console display name: "Street Name".
* `street_no` (string): Value that will be matched against the street number on file, generating a street number matching score where available, otherwise having a weight in the overall address matching score. Console display name: "Street Number".
* `unit_name` (string): Value that will be matched against the unit name on file, generating a unit number matching score where available, otherwise having a weight in the overall address matching score. Console display name: "Unit Name".
* `unit_no` (string): Value that will be matched against the unit number (building number) on file, generating a unit number matching score where available, otherwise having a weight in the overall address matching score. Console display name: "Unit Number".
* `year` (number): Year of birth. This parameter will be used with month and day to generate an overall matching score for DOB. Console display name: "DOB (Year)".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "tmtConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "tmtConnector"
  }

  property {
    name  = "apiKey"
```

## Tableau

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorTableau`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `addFlowPermissionsRequestBody` (string): Add Flow Permissions Request Body in XML Format. Example: <tsRequest><task><flowRun><flow id="flow-id"/><flowRunSpec><flowParameterSpecs><flowParameterSpec parameterId="parameter-id" overrideValue= "overrideValue"/><flowParameterSpecs><flowRunSpec></flowRun></task></tsRequest>. Console display name: "Add Flow Permissions Request Body in XML Format.".
* `addUsertoSiteRequestBody` (string): Add User to Site Request Body in XML Format. Example: <tsRequest><user name="user-name" siteRole="site-role" authSetting="auth-setting" /></tsRequest>. Console display name: "Add User to Site Request Body in XML Format.".
* `apiVersion` (string): The version of the API to use, such as 3.16. Console display name: "api-version".
* `authId` (string): The Tableau-Auth sent along with every request. Console display name: "auth-ID".
* `createScheduleBody` (string): This should contain the entire XML. Eg: <tsRequest><schedule name="schedule-name"priority="schedule-priority"type="schedule-type"frequency="schedule-frequency"executionOrder="schedule-execution-order"><frequencyDetails start="start-time" end="end-time"><intervals><interval interval-expression /></intervals></frequencyDetails></schedule></tsRequest>. Console display name: "XML file format to be used for creating schedule".
* `datasourceId` (string): The ID of the flow. Console display name: "datasource-id".
* `flowId` (string): The flow-id value for the flow you want to add permissions to. Console display name: "flow-id".
* `groupId` (string): The ID of the group. Console display name: "group-id".
* `jobId` (string): The ID of the job. Console display name: "job-id".
* `scheduleId` (string): The ID of the schedule that you are associating with the data source. Console display name: "schedule-id".
* `serverUrl` (string): The tableau server URL Example: https://www.tableau.com:8030. Console display name: "server-url".
* `siteId` (string): The ID of the site that contains the view. Console display name: "site-id".
* `taskId` (string): The ID of the extract refresh task. Console display name: "task-id".
* `updateScheduleRequestBody` (string): This should contain the entire XML. Eg: <tsRequest><schedule name="hourly-schedule-1" priority="50" type="Extract" frequency="Hourly" executionOrder="Parallel"><frequencyDetails start="18:30:00" end="23:00:00"><intervals><interval hours="2" /></intervals></frequencyDetails></schedule></tsRequest>. Console display name: "XML file format to be used for updating schedule".
* `updateUserRequestBody` (string): Update User Request Body in XML Format. <tsRequest><user fullName="new-full-name" email="new-email" password="new-password" siteRole="new-site-role" authSetting="new-auth-setting" /></tsRequest>. Console display name: "Update User Request Body in XML Format.".
* `userId` (string): The ID of the user to get/give information for. Console display name: "user-id".
* `workbookId` (string): The ID of the workbook to add to the schedule. Console display name: "workbook-id".


Example:

* `retrieveGroup_id` (string): Group id. Console display name: "Id".
* `retrieveGroups_name_filter` (string): Name of the entity to be retrieved. Console display name: "NameFilter".
* `retrieveGroups_page` (string): Number of the page to be returned. If you put 2, the second page of the query result is returned. Console display name: "Page".
* `retrieveGroups_size` (string): Number of retrieved entities on each page. The range is from 1 to 100. Console display name: "Size".
* `retrieveRoles_name_filter` (string): Name of the entity to be retrieved. Console display name: "NameFilter".
* `retrieveRoles_page` (string): Number of the page to be returned. If you put 2, the second page of the query result is returned. Console display name: "Page".
* `retrieveRoles_size` (string): Number of retrieved entities on each page. The range is from 1 to 100. Console display name: "Size".
* `retrieveUserDetails_id` (string): User id. Console display name: "Id".
* `retrieveUsers1_page` (string): Number of the page to be returned. If you put 2, the second page of the query result is returned. Console display name: "Page".
* `retrieveUsers1_size` (string): Number of retrieved entities on each page. The range is from 1 to 100. Console display name: "Size".
* `retrieveUsers_id` (string): Role id. Console display name: "Id".
* `retrieveUsers_page` (string): Number of the page to be returned. If you put 2, the second page of the query result is returned. Console display name: "Page".
* `retrieveUsers_size` (string): Number of retrieved entities on each page. The range is from 1 to 100. Console display name: "Size".
* `securityRoleMappingsCustomerRoleNameDelete_customer_role_name` (string): Customer role name. Console display name: "CustomerRoleName".
* `securityRoleMappingsCustomerRoleNameGet_customer_role_name` (string): Customer role name. Console display name: "CustomerRoleName".
* `updatePermissions1_permission` (string): The collection of permissions to update. Console display name: "Permission".
* `updatePermissions2_permission` (string): The collection of permissions to update. Console display name: "Permission".
* `updateRole_id` (string): Role id. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateRole_role_Role_name` (string): Name of the role. Console display name: "Name".
* `updateRole_role_Role_permissions` (string): List of permissions associated with the role. Console display name: "Permissions".
* `updateUser1_id` (string): User id. Console display name: "Id".
* `updateUser1_user_User_active` (string): Boolean indicating if the user is active. Console display name: "Active".
* `updateUser1_user_User_email` (string): Email of the user. Console display name: "Email".
* `updateUser1_user_User_firstName` (string): First name of the user. Console display name: "FirstName".
* `updateUser1_user_User_lastName` (string): Last name of the user. Console display name: "LastName".
* `updateUser1_user_User_login` (string): Login of the user. Console display name: "Login".
* `updateUser1_user_User_password` (string): Password of the user. Console display name: "Password".
* `updateUser1_user_User_phone` (string): Phone of the user. Console display name: "Phone".
* `updateUser1_user_User_preferredLanguage` (string): Preferred language of the user. Console display name: "PreferredLanguage".
* `updateUser1_user_User_roleIds` (string): List of roles ids for the user. Console display name: "RoleIds".
* `updateUser1_user_User_timezone` (string): Timezone of the user. Console display name: "Timezone".
* `updateUser1_user_User_title` (string): Title of the user. Console display name: "Title".
* `updateWorkspacePermissions1_request_body` (string): Rights to update on the permission. Example: ["AUTHOR","EXECUTE"]. Console display name: "Request_body".
* `updateWorkspacePermissions1_service_account_id` (string): The user for which rights will be applied. Example Value: b9e10a3f-9d68-44bb-862f-b2aa56dc7191. Console display name: "ServiceAccountId".
* `updateWorkspacePermissions1_workspace_id` (string): The workspace where rights will be applied. Example Value: 6089228181ef4423736e47a9. Console display name: "WorkspaceId".
* `updateWorkspacePermissions2_request_body` (string): Rights to update on the permission. Example: ["AUTHOR","EXECUTE"]. Console display name: "Request_body".
* `updateWorkspacePermissions2_user_id` (string): The user for which rights will be applied. Example Value: b9e10a3f-9d68-44bb-862f-b2aa56dc7191. Console display name: "UserId".
* `updateWorkspacePermissions2_workspace_id` (string): The workspace where rights will be applied. Example Value: 6089228181ef4423736e47a9. Console display name: "WorkspaceId".

## Teleport

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `nodeConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `inputSchema` (string): Follow example for JSON schema. Console display name: "".
* `linkStartNode` (string): Console display name: "Navigate to Start Node".
* `nodeInstanceId` (string): The start node to go to when the flow reaches this node. Tip: When defining a start node, give it a unique title on the "Settings" tab. Console display name: "".
* `outputSchema` (string): Follow example for JSON schema. Console display name: "".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "nodeConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "nodeConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome nodeConnector"
  property {
    name  = "inputSchema"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.nodeconnector_property_input_schema
  }
  property {
    name  = "linkStartNode"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.nodeconnector_property_link_start_node
  }
  property {
    name  = "nodeInstanceId"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.nodeconnector_property_node_instance_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "outputSchema"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.nodeconnector_property_output_schema
  }
}
```


## Telesign

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `telesignConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `address` (string): The home address of the person you want a match for. Console display name: "Address".
* `authDescription` (string): Console display name: "".
* `authDescriptionDetail` (string): Console display name: "".
* `billing_postal_code` (string): The postal code for the billing address of the contact you want information for. Console display name: "Billing Postal code".
* `city` (string): The name of the city associated with the address of the person you want to match for. Console display name: "City".
* `connectorName` (string): Console display name: "".
* `consentMethod` (string): Console display name: "".
* `consentTimeStamp` (string): Timestamp of when user consent was obtained. example: 2020-05-01T00:30:30Z. Console display name: "Consent Timestamp".
* `country` (string): The name of the country associated with the address you are requesting a match for. Console display name: "Country".
* `date_of_birth` (string): An optional parameter available only in Brazil and the UK that allows you to submit a contact’s date of birth (DOB) for a match score. The format is ISO 8601, so year-month-date. For example: 1978-08-22. Console display name: "Date of Birth".
* `description` (string): Console display name: "".
* `details1` (string): Console display name: "".
* `details2` (string): Console display name: "".
* `first_name` (string): The first name of the person you want to find a match for. Console display name: "First Name".
* `iconUrl` (string): Console display name: "".
* `iconUrlPng` (string): Console display name: "".
* `last_name` (string): The last name of the person you want a match for. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `last_verified` (string): The last date and time you successfully verified this user’s identity. If this parameter is included, the response includes additional sub-properties within the number_deactivation package. The value must be formatted according to the ISO-8601 standard. Console display name: "Last Verified".
* `message` (string): Console display name: "".
* `otp` (string): Console display name: "".
* `password` (string): Console display name: "".
* `past_x_days` (string): How many days back the service will go to check for whether the phone number was ported. Console display name: "Past (x) days".
* `phoneIdAddOns` (string): Console display name: "".
* `phoneNumber` (string): Enter either a hard coded phone number in E.164 format(+14151234567) or a parameter {}. Console display name: "".
* `postal_code` (string): A series of letters, digits or both included in a postal address to help with sorting mail. Enter the postal code you want to find a match for here. Console display name: "Postal Code".
* `providerName` (string): Console display name: "".
* `screen0Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `screen1Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `screen2Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `screen3Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `screen4Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `screen5Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `showCredAddedOn` (string): Console display name: "".
* `showCredAddedVia` (string): Console display name: "".
* `skWebhookUri` (string): Console display name: "Redirect Webhook URI".
* `state` (string): The name of the state you want a match for. Console display name: "State".
* `title` (string): Console display name: "".
* `toolTip` (string): Console display name: "".
* `useScore20` (string): Console display name: "".
* `username` (string): Console display name: "".
* `voiceOtpLanguage` (string): A code specifying the language of the predefined template you wish to use. Console display name: "Language".
* `voiceOtpPhoneNumber` (string): The end user's phone number, as a string of digits without spaces or punctuation, beginning with the country dialing code (for example, "1" for North America). Console display name: "Phone Number".


Example:

```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "telesignConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "telesignConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome telesignConnector"

    name  = "address"
```

## Token Management

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `skOpenIdConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accessTokenExpiry` (string): Console display name: "".
* `claimsNameValuePairs` (string): Console display name: "".
* `claimsNameValuePairsAccessToken` (string): Console display name: "".
* `claimsNameValuePairsSessionToken` (string): Console display name: "".
* `createAccessTokenFlag` (string): Console display name: "".
* `createIdTokenFlag` (string): Console display name: "".
* `createSessionTokenFlag` (string): Console display name: "".
* `customErrorFlag` (string): Console display name: "".
* `customScopes` (string): Console display name: "".
* `customScopesFlag` (string): Console display name: "".
* `customScopesSeparateField` (string): Console display name: "".
* `customScopesSeparateFieldName` (string): Console display name: "".
* `errorCode` (string): Console display name: "".
* `errorDescription` (string): Console display name: "".
* `errorMessage` (string): Console display name: "".
* `errorOnExpiry` (string): When enabled, the token is considered valid only if it has not expired. Console display name: "Validate Expiration Time".
* `errorReason` (string): Console display name: "".
* `genericToken` (string): The JWT token to validate. Console display name: "".
* `idTokenExpiry` (string): Console display name: "".
* `publicKeyId` (string): A unique identifier for the public key, used to identify the correct key when multiple keys are in use or have been rotated. Used for tokens created with RS*, ES*, or PS* algorithms that use key IDs. Console display name: "Public Key ID".
* `publicKeyJWTEndpointURL` (string): The JWKS endpoint for the public key associated with the private key that was used to create the JWT token, such as "https://yourcompany.com/.well-known/jwks.json". For tokens created with RS*, ES*, or PS* algorithms, you must provide the key here or in the Public Key PEM Contents field. Console display name: "Public Key JWKS Endpoint URL".
* `publicKeyPEMContents` (string): The public key associated with the private key that was used to create the JWT token. The key must be in PEM format, which includes the `-----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY-----` and `-----END PUBLIC KEY-----` delimiters. For tokens created with RS*, ES*, or PS* algorithms, you must provide the key here or in the Public Key JWKS Endpoint URL. Console display name: "Public Key PEM Contents".
* `publicKeyType` (string): Select whether to provide a key directly from DaVinci, by pasting a public key PEM file, or by pointing to a JWKS file by URL. Console display name: "Public Key Type".
* `resolveToUser` (string): Console display name: "".
* `secretKey` (string): The symmetric key used to create the JWT token. Required for tokens created with HS* algorithms. Console display name: "Secret Key".
* `sessionToken` (string): Console display name: "".
* `sessionTokenExpiry` (string): Console display name: "".
* `sessionTokenLocation` (string): Console display name: "".
* `sessionTokenName` (string): Console display name: "".
* `shadowUserNotPresentFlag` (string): Console display name: "".
* `validAlgorithms` (string): The token is considered valid only if it was created using one of the select algorithms. Console display name: "Valid Algorithms".
* `validAudiences` (string): The token is considered valid only if the claim is for one of the listed audiences. Enter an audience, such as "https://api.example.com", and press enter. Leave blank to accept any audience. Console display name: "Valid Audiences".
* `validIssuers` (string): The token is considered valid only if it came from one of the listed issuers. Enter an issuer name, such as "https://sso.yourcompany.com", and press enter. Leave blank to accept any issuer. Console display name: "Valid Issuers".
* `validSubjects` (string): The token is considered valid only if the claim is for one of the listed subjects. Enter a subject, such as "rkwong", and press enter. Leave blank to accept any subject. Console display name: "Valid Subjects".

## TransUnion TLOxp

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `tutloxpConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `addressLineOne` (string): The Line One Address of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Address Line One".
* `addressLineThree` (string): The Line Three Address of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Address Line Three".
* `addressLineTwo` (string): The Line Two Address of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Address Line Two".
* `apiUrl` (string): The URL for your TransUnion API. Unnecessary to change unless you're testing against a demo tenant. Console display name: "API URL".
* `city` (string): The resident city of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "City".
* `country` (string): The resident country of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Country".
* `doNotModifySearch` (string): Inform the Verify Plus service to modify the search parameters if a good match is not found. Console display name: "Do Not Modify Search".
* `dobDay` (string): The day portion of the birth date of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Birth Day".
* `dobMonth` (string): The month portion of the birth date of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Birth Month".
* `dobYear` (string): The year portion of the birth date of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Birth Year".
* `dppaCode` (string): The DPPA code that determines the level of data access in the API. Console display name: "DPPA Purpose Code".
* `echoTestInput` (string): A test string for the TransUnion service to echo back. Console display name: "Echo Test Input".
* `findBestMatch` (string): Inform the Verify Plus service to return the best match for the search parameters. Console display name: "Find Best Match".
* `firstName` (string): The first name of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "First Name".
* `glbCode` (string): The GLB code that determines the level of data access in the API. Console display name: "GLB Purpose Code".
* `lastName` (string): The last name of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `middleName` (string): The middle name of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Middle Name".
* `password` (string): The password for your API User. Console display name: "Password".
* `reportToken` (string): The token returned from a Verify Plus response. Console display name: "Report Token".
* `ssn` (string): The social security number of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "Social Security Number".
* `state` (string): The resident state of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "State".
* `username` (string): The username for your API user. Console display name: "Username".
* `zip` (string): The resident ZIP Code of the identity you want to verify with Verify Plus. Console display name: "ZIP Code".

## TransUnion TruValidate

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `transunionConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `AccountNumber` (string): Customer Account Number. Console display name: "Account Number".
* `Address1` (string): Address 1. Console display name: "Address 1".
* `Address2` (string): Address 2. Console display name: "Address 2".
* `Address3` (string): Address 3. Console display name: "Address 3".
* `AddressType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `AuthURL` (string): Auth URL. Console display name: "Auth URL".
* `BINNumber` (string): BIN Number. Console display name: "BIN Number".
* `CaseId` (string): ID of the Case. Console display name: "Case ID".
* `CaseStatusType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `CaseType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `City` (string): Current City of the customer. Console display name: "City".
* `Comment` (string): Case Status Comment. Console display name: "Comment".
* `CountryCode` (string): Console display name: "Country Code".
* `Currency` (string): Currency. Console display name: "Currency".
* `CustomerId` (string): Console display name: "Customer ID".
* `DateOfBirth` (string): Date of Birth of the Customer. Console display name: "Date of Birth".
* `Emails` (string): Customer's Email. Console display name: "Email".
* `FirstName` (string): First Name. Console display name: "First Name".
* `GeoLocation` (string): Console display name: "".
* `IdentityConsentId` (string): Identity Consent Id. Console display name: "Identity Consent Id".
* `ItemValue` (number): Item Value. Console display name: "Item Value".
* `LastName` (string): Last Name. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `LocationConsentId` (string): Location Consent ID. Console display name: "Location Consent ID".
* `LongTermAccessToken` (string): Long Term Access Token of customer's social account. Console display name: "Long Term Access Token".
* `LongTermAccessTokenExpiry` (string): Long Term Access Token Expiry of customer's social account. Console display name: "Long Term Access Token Expiry".
* `MarketType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `Method` (string): Console display name: "".
* `OTPLanguageEnum` (string): Console display name: "".
* `OTPStatus` (string): Console display name: "".
* `Passcode` (string): Passcode. Console display name: "Passcode".
* `PaymentType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `PhoneDeliveryType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `PhoneNumber` (string): Console display name: "Phone Number".
* `PostalCode` (string): Postal Code. Console display name: "Postal Code".
* `Secret` (string): Secret of customer's social account. Console display name: "Secret".
* `ShortTermAccessToken` (string): Short Term Access Token of customer's social account. Console display name: "Short Term Access Token".
* `ShortTermAccessTokenExpiry` (string): Short Term Access Token Expiry of customer's social account. Console display name: "Short Term Access Token Expiry".
* `SocialId` (number): Social Id. Console display name: "Social Id".
* `SocialNetworkType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `SocialSecurityNumber` (string): Social Security Number. Console display name: "Social Security Number".
* `State` (string): State. Console display name: "State".
* `TimeToFulfilment` (string): Console display name: "".
* `TotalTransactionValue` (number): Total Transaction Value. Console display name: "Total Transaction Value".
* `TransactionItemName` (string): Transaction Item Name. Console display name: "Name".
* `TransactionItemQuantity` (number): Transaction Item Quantity. Console display name: "Quantity".
* `TransactionProcessingTime` (string): Transaction Processing Time. Console display name: "Transaction Processing Time".
* `apiUrl` (string): The Base API URL for TransUnion. Console display name: "Base URL".
* `customCSS` (string): Console display name: "CSS".
* `customHTML` (string): Console display name: "HTML Template".
* `customScript` (string): Write custom JavaScript. Caution: Custom code is for advanced users only. Before using custom code, review the security risks in the DaVinci documentation by searching for "Using custom code safely". Console display name: "Script".
* `docVerificationPassword` (string): Password for Document Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Password".
* `docVerificationPublicKey` (string): Public Key for Document Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Public Key".
* `docVerificationSecret` (string): Secret for Document Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Secret".
* `docVerificationSiteId` (string): Site ID for Document Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Site ID".
* `docVerificationUsername` (string): Username for Document Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Username".
* `documentBackCaptureAttempts` (number): This value specifies the number of back capture attempts the user is allowed to use to capture a good image, after this threshold the last image is used. Default: 4. Console display name: "Document Back Capture Attempt".
* `documentEnableFaceDetection` (boolean): This flag specifies if the face detection should be enabled when the Document image is captured. Console display name: "Document Enable Face Detection".
* `documentFrontCaptureAttempts` (number): This value specifies the number of front capture attempts the user is allowed to use to capture a good image, after this threshold the last image is used. Default: 4. Console display name: "Document Front Capture Attempt".
* `documentGoodImageFoundADA` (string): message when good image is found. Console display name: "Document Good Image Found ADA".
* `documentIsBarcodeDetectedEnabled` (boolean): This flag specifies if the Barcode detection should be enabled when the Document image is captured. Console display name: "Document Enable Barcode Detection".
* `documentManualTimeout` (number): This value specifies after how many seconds to pass before the capture mode is switched from Auto to Manual. Console display name: "Document Set Manual Timeout in Seconds".
* `documentNotGoodImageADA` (string): message when no good image is found. Console display name: "Document Not Good Image ADA".
* `documentNotificationADA` (string): Document Notification ADA. Console display name: "Document Notification ADA".
* `documentOverlayColor` (string): This value is used to color the text shown on the document capture screen. The value should be in CSS3 Hex format. Console display name: "Document Overlay Color".
* `documentOverlayText` (string): This message is shown on top of the Document capture screen when the documentCaptureMode is set to Manual. Console display name: "Document Overlay Text Manual".
* `documentOverlayTextAuto` (string): This message is shown on top of the document capture screen when the documentCaptureMode is set to Auto. Console display name: "Document Overlay Text Auto".
* `documentOverlayTextAutoADA` (string): Document Overlay Text Auto ADA. Console display name: "Document Overlay Text Auto ADA".
* `documentOverlayTextManualADA` (string): Document Overlay Text Manual ADA. Console display name: "Document Overlay Text Manual ADA".
* `frontCaptureMode` (string): This value specifies if the Document image should be captured in Auto or Manual mode. Console display name: "Document Capture Mode".
* `htmlConfig` (string): Console display name: "".
* `idVerificationPassword` (string): Password for ID Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Password".
* `idVerificationPayloadUrl` (string): ID Verification Payload Url from the Get Detailed Decision capability's output. Console display name: "ID Verification Payload Url".
* `idVerificationPublicKey` (string): Public Key for ID Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Public Key".
* `idVerificationSecret` (string): Secret for ID Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Secret".
* `idVerificationSiteId` (string): Site ID for ID Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Site ID".
* `idVerificationUsername` (string): Username for ID Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Username".
* `kbaPassword` (string): Password for KBA, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Password".
* `kbaPublicKey` (string): Public Key for KBA, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Public Key".
* `kbaSecret` (string): Secret for KBA, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Secret".
* `kbaSiteId` (string): Site ID for KBA, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Site ID".
* `kbaUsername` (string): Username for KBA, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Username".
* `licenseFaceDetectionProportionMax` (string): Console display name: "License Face Detection Proportion Max".
* `licenseFaceDetectionProportionMin` (number): Console display name: "License Face Detection Proportion Min".
* `nativeBackFocusThreshold` (number): Console display name: "Native Back Focus Threshold".
* `nativeBackGlareThreshold` (number): Console display name: "Native Back Glare Threshold".
* `nativeFrontFocusThreshold` (number): Console display name: "Native Front Focus Threshold".
* `nativeFrontGlareThreshold` (number): Console display name: "Native Front Glare Threshold".
* `otpPassword` (string): Password for otp Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Password".
* `otpPublicKey` (string): Public Key for otp Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Public Key".
* `otpSecret` (string): Secret for otp Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Secret".
* `otpSiteId` (string): Site ID for otp Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Site ID".
* `otpUsername` (string): Username for otp Verification, provided by TransUnion. Console display name: "Username".
* `passportFaceDetectionProportionMax` (string): Console display name: "Passport Face Detection Proportion Max".
* `passportFaceDetectionProportionMin` (number): Console display name: "Passport Face Detection Proportion Min".
* `passportFrontCaptureAttempts` (number): This value specifies the number of passport front capture attempts the user is allowed to use to capture a good image, after this threshold the last image is used. Default: 4. Console display name: "Passport Front Capture Attempt".
* `screen0Config` (string): Console display name: "".
* `selfieCaptureAttempts` (number): This value specifies the number of selfie capture attempts the user is allowed to use to capture a good image, after this threshold the last image is used. Default: 2. Console display name: "Selfie Front Capture Attempt".
* `selfieCaptureMode` (string): Console display name: "".
* `selfieEnableFaceDetection` (boolean): This flag specifies if the face detection should be enabled when the Selfie image is captured. Console display name: "Selfie Enable Face Detection".
* `selfieGoodImageFoundADA` (string): message when good image is found. Console display name: "Selfie Good Image Found ADA".
* `selfieManualTimeout` (number): This value specifies after how many seconds to pass before the capture mode is switched from Auto to Manual. Console display name: "Selfie Set Manual Timeout in Seconds".
* `selfieNotGoodImageADA` (string): message when no good image is found. Console display name: "Selfie Not Good Image ADA".
* `selfieNotificationADA` (string): Selfie Notification ADA. Console display name: "Selfie Notification ADA".
* `selfieOrientationErrorText` (string): Console display name: "Selfie Orientation Error Text".
* `selfieOverlayText` (string): Console display name: "Selfie Overlay Text".
* `selfieOverlayTextAuto` (string): Console display name: "Selfie Overlay Text Auto".
* `selfieOverlayTextAutoADA` (string): Selfie Overlay Text Auto ADA. Console display name: "Selfie Overlay Text Auto ADA".
* `selfieOverlayTextManualADA` (string): Selfie Overlay Text Manual ADA. Console display name: "Selfie Overlay Text Manual ADA".
* `selfieUseBackCamera` (boolean): This flag specifies if the selfie should use back camera. Console display name: "Selfie use Back Camera".
* `transunionAuthType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `useCustomScreens` (string): Console display name: "Use Custom Screens".
* `validationBadFocusText` (string): Console display name: "Validation Bad Focus Text ".
* `validationBadGlareText` (string): Console display name: "Validation Bad Glare Text ".
* `validationDefaultText` (string): validation error text. Console display name: "Validation Default Text".
* `validationNoBarcodeText` (string): Console display name: "Validation No Barcode Text".
* `validationNoFacesFoundText` (string): Console display name: "Validation No Face Found Text".
* `validationOkButtonColor` (string): Console display name: "Validation OK Button Color ".
* `validationOkButtonText` (string): Console display name: "Validation OK Button Text ".

## Treasure Data

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `treasureDataConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiKey` (string): Treasure Data API Key. Console display name: "API Key".
* `attributes` (string): This property needs to be a properly formatted JSON value. It can contain DaVinci parameters, which will be replaced at runtime. If you are using DaVinci parameters that are of type 'string', you will need to put string quotes around it. Console display name: "Attributes".
* `audienceId` (string): Master Segment ID of the token. Console display name: "Audience ID".
* `body` (string): This property needs to be a properly formatted JSON value. It can contain DaVinci parameters, which will be replaced at runtime. If you are using DaVinci parameters that are of type 'string', you will need to put string quotes around it. Console display name: "HTTP Body (JSON)".
* `database` (string): Database from your Treasure Data account. Console display name: "Database".
* `endpoint` (string): Add the full API URL, including protocol, base URL, and endpoint. Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `headers` (string): Add HTTP headers and provide their values. Console display name: "Headers".
* `id` (string): Token to update. Console display name: "Token ID".
* `method` (string): The HTTP Method. Console display name: "Method".
* `queryParameters` (string): Add query parameters and provide their values. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `recordData` (string): Request object for ingesting a single record. Console display name: "Record Data".
* `regionRecord` (string): Select the appropriate region. This is used to define the base URL. Console display name: "Region".
* `regionToken` (string): Select the appropriate region. This is used to define the base URL. Console display name: "Region".
* `relationships` (string): This property needs to be a properly formatted JSON value. It can contain DaVinci parameters, which will be replaced at runtime. If you are using DaVinci parameters that are of type 'string', you will need to put string quotes around it. Console display name: "Relationships".
* `table` (string): Table from your Treasure Data account. Console display name: "Table".
* `type` (string): Value: 'token'. Console display name: "Type".

## Vericlouds

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorVericlouds`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiSecret` (string): The API secret assigned by VeriClouds to the customer. The secret is also used for decrypting sensitive data such as leaked passwords. It is important to never share the secret with any 3rd party. Console display name: "apiSecret".
* `apikey` (string): The API key assigned by VeriClouds to the customer. Console display name: "apiKey".
* `identifier` (string): The user's identifier value (email, username, or phone number). Console display name: "Identifier".
* `identifierType` (string): The type of identifier. The Vericlouds connector currently accepts email, username, or phone_number. Console display name: "identifierType".
* `password` (string): User's Password. Console display name: "Password".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connectorVericlouds" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connectorVericlouds"
  }
  name = "My awesome connectorVericlouds"
  property {
    name  = "apiSecret"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorvericlouds_property_api_secret
  }
  property {
    name  = "apikey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorvericlouds_property_apikey
  }
  property {
    name  = "identifier"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorvericlouds_property_identifier
  }
  property {
    name  = "identifierType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorvericlouds_property_identifier_type
  }
  property {
    name  = "password"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectorvericlouds_property_password
  }
}
```


## Veriff

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `veriffConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `access_token` (string): The API Key provided by Veriff, such as "323aa031-b4af-4e12-b354-de0da91a2ab0". Console display name: "API Key".
* `baseUrl` (string): The API URL to target, such as “https://stationapi.veriff.com/”. Console display name: "Base URL".
* `body` (string): The raw JSON body. Console display name: "Body".
* `dateOfBirth` (string): The user's date of Birth, formatted as YYYY-MM-DD, such as '1979-01-30'. Console display name: "Date of Birth".
* `documentBack` (string): The Base64-encoded image of the back of the identity document. Console display name: "Document Back".
* `documentFace` (string): The Base64-encoded image of the user's selfie photo. Console display name: "Selfie Image".
* `documentFront` (string): The Base64-encoded image of the front of the identity document. Console display name: "Document Front".
* `endpoint` (string): The Veriff API endpoint, such as “sessions/:sessionID/media”. Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `firstName` (string): The user's first name. Console display name: "First Name".
* `gender` (string): The user's gender, such as 'male' or 'female'. Console display name: "Gender".
* `headers` (string): HTTP headers and values to use in the call. Console display name: "Headers".
* `identificationNumber` (string): The user's national identification number, such as 'AB123456C'. Console display name: "National Identification Number".
* `lastName` (string): The user's last name. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `method` (string): The method to use for the call. Console display name: "Method".
* `password` (string): The Share Secret Key from Veriff to create HMAC signature, such as "20bf4sf0-fbg7-488c-b4f1-d9594lf707bk". Console display name: "Shared Secret Key".
* `queryParameters` (string): Add query parameters and provide their values. Console display name: "Query parameters and values to include in the call".
* `sessionId` (string): The user’s Veriff session ID. Use the Create Session capability to get a session ID. Console display name: "Session ID".
* `vendorData` (string): Your organization's unique identifier for the user. This value is returned by Veriff in the Receive Webhook Response capability, which allows you to identify users that submit multiple different photos or documents using the same user identifier. Console display name: "Vendor Data".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "veriffConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "veriffConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome veriffConnector"
  property {
    name  = "access_token"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_access_token
  }
  property {
    name  = "baseUrl"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_base_url
  }
  property {
    name  = "body"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_body
  }
  property {
    name  = "dateOfBirth"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_date_of_birth
  }
  property {
    name  = "documentBack"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_document_back
  }
  property {
    name  = "documentFace"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_document_face
  }
  property {
    name  = "documentFront"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_document_front
  }
  property {
    name  = "endpoint"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_endpoint
  }
  property {
    name  = "firstName"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_first_name
  }
  property {
    name  = "gender"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_gender
  }
  property {
    name  = "headers"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_headers
  }
  property {
    name  = "identificationNumber"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_identification_number
  }
  property {
    name  = "lastName"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_last_name
  }
  property {
    name  = "method"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_method
  }
  property {
    name  = "password"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_password
  }
  property {
    name  = "queryParameters"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_query_parameters
  }
  property {
    name  = "sessionId"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_session_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "vendorData"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.veriffconnector_property_vendor_data
  }
}
```


## Verosint

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connector443id`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiKey` (string): This is the API key from your Verosint account. Remember, Your API KEY is like a serial number for your policy. If you want to utilize more than one policy, you can generate another API KEY and tailor that to a custom policy. Console display name: "API Key".
* `email` (string): The user's email address. Console display name: "Email".
* `eventType` (string): Event type (LOGIN_SUCCESS, LOGIN_FAILED, MFA_SUCCESS, MFA_FAILED, VERIFICATION_SUCCESS). Console display name: "Event Type".
* `identifiers` (string): Identifiers: IP, email, phone. Console display name: "Identifiers".
* `ip` (string): IPv4 address or IPv6 global unicast address. Console display name: "IP Address".
* `phone` (string): Phone number with no spaces, and includes "+", Country Code, & Subscriber Number. Console display name: "Phone Number".
* `ruleUuid` (string): The ruleset UUID. Console display name: "RuleSet UUID".
* `timestamp` (string): timestamp of the event. Console display name: "Timestamp".
* `userAgent` (string): The user's userAgent. Console display name: "UserAgent".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connector443id" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connector443id"
  }
  name = "My awesome connector443id"
  property {
    name  = "apiKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_api_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "email"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_email
  }
  property {
    name  = "eventType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_event_type
  }
  property {
    name  = "identifiers"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_identifiers
  }
  property {
    name  = "ip"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_ip
  }
  property {
    name  = "phone"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_phone
  }
  property {
    name  = "ruleUuid"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_rule_uuid
  }
  property {
    name  = "timestamp"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_timestamp
  }
  property {
    name  = "userAgent"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connector443id_property_user_agent
  }
}
```


## Vidos

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `mailchainConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiKey` (string): Enter your Vidos API Key obtained from the Vidos Dashboard with appropriate resolver or verifier permissions (visit https://dashboard.vidos.id/iam/api-keys). Console display name: "Vidos API Key".
* `bodyCredential` (string): Insert your DaVinci parameter here. This parameter needs to be a verifiable credential represented as a valid JSON object in the format e.g. {'@context: […],type: verifiableCredential', …}. Console display name: "Verifiable Credential".
* `bodyPresentation` (string): Insert your DaVinci parameter here. This parameter needs to be a verifiable presentation represented as a valid JSON object in the format e.g. {'@context: […],type: verifiablePresentation', …}. Console display name: "Verifiable Presentation".
* `did` (string): Insert your DaVinci parameter here. This parameter needs to be a DID string in the format did:method:1234…abc, e.g. 'did:key:z6Mki…oWp'. Console display name: "Decentralized Identifier".
* `endpoint` (string): Enter your Vidos Universal Resolver URL obtained from the Vidos Dashboard (visit https://dashboard.vidos.id/resolvers/instances/). Console display name: "Resolver Instance URL".
* `endpointVerify` (string): Enter your Vidos Verifier URL obtained from the Vidos Dashboard (visit https://dashboard.vidos.id/verifiers/instances). Console display name: "Verifier Endpoint".
* `optionalParams` (string): Console display name: "Optional Params".
* `version` (string): The verification API specification version. Console display name: "Verifier Version".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "mailchainConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "mailchainConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome mailchainConnector"
  property {
    name  = "apiKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mailchainconnector_property_api_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "bodyCredential"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mailchainconnector_property_body_credential
  }
  property {
    name  = "bodyPresentation"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mailchainconnector_property_body_presentation
  }
  property {
    name  = "did"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mailchainconnector_property_did
  }
  property {
    name  = "endpoint"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mailchainconnector_property_endpoint
  }
  property {
    name  = "endpointVerify"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mailchainconnector_property_endpoint_verify
  }
  property {
    name  = "optionalParams"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mailchainconnector_property_optional_params
  }
  property {
    name  = "version"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mailchainconnector_property_version
  }
}
```
