Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accessToken` (string): WhatsApp Access Token. Console display name: "Access Token".
* `appSecret` (string): WhatsApp App Secret for the application, it is used to verify the webhook signatures. Console display name: "App Secret".
* `body` (string): The raw formatted JSON body. Console display name: "Body".
* `endpoint` (string): The WhatsApp Business API endpoint, such as "/messages/register/deregister/media/request_code". Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `fromId` (string): WhatsApp from phone number ID. Console display name: "From Phone Number ID".
* `headers` (string): Add HTTP headers and provide their values. Console display name: "Headers".
* `interactiveMessagetemplateName` (string): WhatsApp interactive template name (from WhatsApp dashboard). Console display name: "Interactive Message Template Name".
* `mediaMessageTemplateName` (string): WhatsApp media template name (from WhatsApp dashboard). Console display name: "Media Message Template Name".
* `mediaMessageUrl` (string): Media URL for the image being sent. Console display name: "Media Message URL".
* `messageLanguageCode` (string): Define the language code of the messsage. Console display name: "Language Code".
* `messageType` (string): WhatsApp message type. Console display name: "Message Type".
* `method` (string): The HTTP Method. Console display name: "Method".
* `queryParameters` (string): Add query parameters and provide their values. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `skWebhookUri` (string): Console display name: "Redirect Webhook URI".
* `templateArgumentList` (string): Variables for WhatsApp message template. Console display name: "Template Variables".
* `textMessageTemplateName` (string): WhatsApp text message template name (from WhatsApp dashboard). Console display name: "Text Message Template Name".
* `to` (string): Recipient of the WhatsApp message. Console display name: "Recipient".
* `verifyToken` (string): Meta webhook verify token. Console display name: "Webhook Verify Token".
* `version` (string): WhatsApp Graph API Version. Console display name: "Version".

## Yoti

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `yotiConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `addressLine1` (string): The first line of the user's address, such as "123 Main Street". Console display name: "Address Line 1".
* `addressLine2` (string): The second line of the user's address, such as "Unit 10". Console display name: "Address Line 2".
* `addressLine3` (string): The third line of the user's address. Console display name: "Address Line 3".
* `authType` (string): Console display name: "".
* `button` (string): Console display name: "Yoti".
* `challenge` (string): Console display name: "".
* `country` (string): The user's country, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format, such as "US". Console display name: "Country".
* `customAuth` (string): Console display name: "".
* `customCSS` (string): Console display name: "CSS".
* `customHTML` (string): Console display name: "HTML Template".
* `dateOfBirth` (string): Date of birth in format "MM/DD/YYYY". Console display name: "Date of Birth".
* `estimationLevel` (string): When enabled, Yoti uses passive analysis to check the image for signs that it might be a 2D image, mask, or bot. Console display name: "Check for Liveness".
* `firstName` (string): The user's first name. Console display name: "First Name".
* `identityVerificationAuthenticity` (string): Determines whether Yoti performs a visual check on the document. For more information, contact your Yoti representative. Console display name: "Additional Authenticity Check".
* `identityVerificationIssuingCountry` (string): The user's three-digit country code, in ISO 3166 Alpha-3 format, such as "USA". Console display name: "Country Code".
* `lastName` (string): The user's last name. Console display name: "Last Name".
* `message` (string): Console display name: "".
* `messageIcon` (string): Console display name: "Message Icon URL".
* `messageIconHeight` (string): Console display name: "Message Icon Height (in pixels)".
* `messageTitle` (string): Console display name: "".
* `postalCode` (string): The user's postal code. Console display name: "Postal Code".
* `sessionId` (string): Console display name: "Session ID".
* `showFooter` (string): Console display name: "".
* `showPoweredBy` (string): Console display name: "".
* `skipButtonPress` (string): Console display name: "".
* `threshold` (string): Enter the required age, such as "21". The user must be over or under this age, depending on the Age Check Method. Console display name: "Age Threshold".
* `type` (string): Determines whether Yoti returns a true or false response or provides the user's numerical age. Console display name: "Age Check Method".

## Zendesk

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorZendesk`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `alias` (string): A User alias displayed to end users. Console display name: "Alias".
* `apiToken` (string): An Active Zendesk API Token (admin center->Apps&Integrations->Zendesk API). Console display name: "Zendesk API Token".
* `body` (string): The raw JSON body, such as { "user": {"email": "jsmith@example.com", "name": "John Smith" } }. Console display name: "Body".
* `chatOnly` (string): Whether or not the user is a chat-only agent. Console display name: "Chat Only Agent".
* `collaborators` (string): Users to add as cc's when creating a ticket. (Input as an array, ex. ['someone@example.com', 'another@example.com'] ). Console display name: "Collaborators".
* `comment` (string): Ticket comments represent the conversation between requesters, collaborators, and agents. Console display name: "Comment".
* `commentBody` (string): The comment string.  Console display name: "Comment Body".
* `customFields` (string): Custom fields for the ticket. Input as an array of objects (ex.  [{'id': 34, 'value': 'Help please!'},{'id': 12, 'value': 'Printer broken'}]  ). Console display name: "Custom Fields".
* `customRoleID` (string): A custom role if the user is an agent on the Enterprise plan or above. (INTEGER). Console display name: "Custom Role ID".
* `details` (string): Any details you want to store about the user, such as an address. Console display name: "Details".
* `email` (string): The user's primary email address. *Writeable on create only. On update, a secondary email is added. Console display name: "Email".
* `emailCCs` (string): An array of objects that represent agent or end users email CCs to add or delete from the ticket. Console display name: "Email CCs".
* `emailUsername` (string): Email used as 'username' for your Zendesk account. Console display name: "Email of User (username)".
* `endpoint` (string): The Zendesk API endpoint, such as "/api/v2/users.json". Console display name: "Endpoint".
* `externalID` (string): An id you can use to link Zendesk users or tickets to local records. Console display name: "External ID".
* `fileName` (string): The name of the image file. Console display name: "File Name".
* `groupID` (string): The group this ticket is assigned to. (INTEGER). Console display name: "Group ID".
* `headers` (string): Add HTTP headers and provide their values. NOTE: Authorization header will be automatically included. Console display name: "Headers".
* `isPublic` (string): For Tickets: Is true if any comments are public, false otherwise. For Ticket Comments: true if a public comment; false if an internal note. The initial value set on ticket creation persists for any additional comment unless you change it. Console display name: "Is Public?".
* `locale` (string): The user's locale. A BCP-47 compliant tag for the locale. If both 'locale' and 'locale_id' are present on create or update, 'locale_id' is ignored and only 'locale' is used. Console display name: "Locale".
* `method` (string): Method (ex. GET, POST, etc.). Console display name: "Method".
* `moderator` (string): Designates whether the user has forum moderation capabilities. Console display name: "Moderator".
* `name` (string): The user's name. Console display name: "Name".
* `notes` (string): Any notes you want to store about the user. Console display name: "Notes".
* `organizationID` (string): The organization of the requester. You can only specify the ID of an organization associated with the requester. (INTEGER). Console display name: "Organization ID".
* `organizationMembershipID` (string): The ID of the organization membership. (INTEGER). Console display name: "Organization Membership ID".
* `organizationName` (string): The name of the organization associated with this user, in this membership. Console display name: "Organization Name".
* `phone` (string): The user's primary phone number. Console display name: "Phone".
* `priority` (string): The urgency with which the ticket should be addressed. Allowed values are 'urgent', 'high', 'normal', or 'low'. Console display name: "Priority".
* `queryParameters` (string): Add query parameters and provide their values. Console display name: "Query Parameters".
* `recipient` (string): The original recipient e-mail address of the ticket. Notification emails for the ticket are sent from this address. Console display name: "Recipient".
* `role` (string): The user's role. Possible values are 'end-user', 'agent', or 'admin'. Console display name: "Role".
* `safeUpdate` (string): Optional boolean. Prevents updates with outdated ticket data (updated_stamp property required when true).  Console display name: "Safe Update".
* `status` (string): The state of the ticket. Allowed values are 'new', 'open', 'pending', 'hold', 'solved', or 'closed'. Console display name: "Status".
* `subdomain` (string): Your Zendesk subdomain (ex. {subdomain}.zendesk.com/api/v2/...). Console display name: "Subdomain".
* `subject` (string): The value of the subject field for this ticket. Console display name: "Subject".
* `tags` (string): The array of tags applied to this ticket/User. For Users: Only present if your account has user tagging enabled. Console display name: "Tags".
* `ticketFormID` (string): Enterprise only. The id of the ticket form to render for the ticket. (INTEGER). Console display name: "Ticket Form ID".
* `ticketID` (string): The ID for the ticket you want to interact with. Console display name: "Ticket ID".
* `ticketRestriction` (string): Specifies which tickets the user has access to. Possible values are: 'organization', 'groups', 'assigned', 'requested', null. Console display name: "Ticket Restriction".
* `type` (string): The type of this ticket. Allowed values are 'problem', 'incident', 'question', or 'task'. Console display name: "Type".
* `userFields` (string): Values of custom fields in the user's profile. (Enter as JSON object). Console display name: "User Custom Fields".
* `userID` (string): The ID of the user for whom this memberships belongs. (INTEGER). Console display name: "User ID".
* `verified` (string): If you need to create users without sending out a verification email, include a 'verified': true property. Console display name: "Verified Email".
* `viewTickets` (string): Denotes whether the user can or cannot have access to all organization's tickets. Console display name: "View Tickets".

```terraform
  }
```

## Zscaler ZIA

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorZscaler`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `adminUser` (string): default: false. Console display name: "adminUser".
* `basePath` (string): basePath. Console display name: "Base Path".
* `baseURL` (string): baseURL. Console display name: "Base URL".
* `comments` (string): Additional information about this user. Console display name: "Comments".
* `departmentComments` (string): Additional information about this department. Console display name: "Department Comments".
* `departmentDeleted` (string): default: false. Console display name: "Department Deleted".
* `departmentID` (string): Department ID. Console display name: "Department ID".
* `departmentIDPID` (string): Identity provider (IdP) ID. Console display name: "Department IDPID".
* `departmentName` (string): Department name. Console display name: "Department Name".
* `email` (string): User email consists of a user name and domain name. Console display name: "Email".
* `groupsComments` (string): Additional information about the group. Console display name: "Groups Comments".
* `groupsID` (string): Unique identfier for the group. Console display name: "Groups ID".
* `groupsIDPID` (string): Unique identfier for the identity provider. Console display name: "Groups IDPID".
* `groupsName` (string): Group name. Console display name: "Groups Name".
* `limitSearch` (string): Limits the search to match against the department name only. Console display name: "Limit Search".
* `name` (string): User Name. Console display name: "User Name".
* `page` (string): Specifies the page offset. Console display name: "Page".
* `pageSize` (string): Specifies the page size. Console display name: "Page Size".
* `password` (string): User password. Applicable only when authentication type is Hosted DB. Password strength must follow what is defined in the auth settings. Console display name: "User Password".
* `search` (string): The search string used to match against a  name or comments. Console display name: "Search".
* `tempAuthEmail` (string): If you enabled one-time tokens or links, enter the email address to which the Zscaler service sends the tokens or links. If this is empty, the service will send the email to the User email. Console display name: "Temporary Authentication Email".
* `type` (string): type. Console display name: "type".
* `userID` (string): userID. Console display name: "userID".
* `zscalerAPIkey` (string): Zscaler APIkey. Console display name: "Zscaler APIkey".
* `zscalerPassword` (string): Zscaler Domain Password. Console display name: "Zscaler Password".
* `zscalerUsername` (string): Zscaler Domain Username. Console display name: "Zscaler Username".

## iProov API

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `iproovV2Connector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `activate` (string): Mark the user as active on the iProov platform – this should be True by default. Console display name: "Activate".
* `apiKey` (string): Your iProov Service Provider API key. This can be obtained from your iPortal account. Please contact support@iproov.com for more information. Console display name: "iProov API Key".
* `assuranceType` (string): The liveness assurance type, please speak to your iProov representative. Console display name: "Assurance Type".
* `client` (string): Fingerprint or client identifier of the device making the request (e.g. User Agent). Console display name: "Client".
* `image` (string): The image to enrol the user with, in Base64 format. Console display name: "Image".
* `resource` (string): A traffic segregation mechanism based on use case. Please speak to your iProov Solution Architect for more information. Console display name: "Resource".
* `riskProfile` (string): Only used for specific use cases, please speak to your iProov Solution Architect. Console display name: "Risk Profile".
* `secret` (string): Your iProov Service Provider Secret. This can be obtained from your iPortal account. Please contact support@iproov.com for more information. Console display name: "iProov Secret".
* `source` (string): The source of the trusted image: EID = from an electronic identity document (e-Passport), OID = Optically captured document (cropped image of the face), Selfie (Any other trusted source). Console display name: "Source".
* `tenant` (string): The iProov tenant URL (do not include https://). This can be obtained from your iPortal account. Please contact support@iproov.com for more information. Console display name: "iProov Tenant".
* `token` (string): The one time use token generated in the Onboarding (Enrol) step. Console display name: "Token".
* `userId` (string): An anonymised pseudonym for a user. UUID is preferred. This must be stored for future authentication journeys. Console display name: "User ID".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "iproovV2Connector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "iproovV2Connector"
  }
  name = "My awesome iproovV2Connector"
  property {
    name  = "activate"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_activate
  }
  property {
    name  = "apiKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_api_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "assuranceType"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_assurance_type
  }
  property {
    name  = "client"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_client
  }
  property {
    name  = "image"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_image
  }
  property {
    name  = "resource"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_resource
  }
  property {
    name  = "riskProfile"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_risk_profile
  }
  property {
    name  = "secret"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_secret
  }
  property {
    name  = "source"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_source
  }
  property {
    name  = "tenant"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_tenant
  }
  property {
    name  = "token"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_token
  }
  property {
    name  = "userId"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.iproovv2connector_property_user_id
  }
}
```

## ipgeolocation.io

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorIPGeolocationio`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `apiKey` (string): Developer subscription API key. Console display name: "API key".
* `ip` (string): IP address to lookup. Console display name: "IP address".
* `lang` (string): Paid plan subscriptions can get the response in languages other than English. Console display name: "Language".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "connectorIPGeolocationio" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "connectorIPGeolocationio"
  }
  name = "My awesome connectorIPGeolocationio"
  property {
    name  = "apiKey"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoripgeolocationio_property_api_key
  }
  property {
    name  = "ip"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoripgeolocationio_property_ip
  }
  property {
    name  = "lang"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.connectoripgeolocationio_property_lang
  }
}
```

## ipstack

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `connectorIPStack`

## mParticle

Connector ID (`connector.id` in the resource): `mparticleConnector`

Properties (used under the `properties` block in the resource as a key in the JSON object):

* `accountId` (string): Account ID from your mParticle account. Console display name: "Account ID".
* `clientID` (string): Client ID from mParticle tenant. Console display name: "Client ID".
* `clientSecret` (string): Client Secret from mParticle tenant. Console display name: "Client Secret".
* `displayName` (string): The display name of the account. Console display name: "Display Name".
* `jsonBody` (string): This property needs to be a properly formatted JSON value. It can contain DaVinci parameters, which will be replaced at runtime. If you are using DaVinci parameters that are of type 'string', you will need to put string quotes around it. Console display name: "HTTP Body (JSON)".
* `nameOptional` (string): The display name of the account. Console display name: "Display Name".
* `pod` (string): Pod from mParticle tenant. Only required for 'Upload an event batch' capability. Console display name: "Pod".
* `updatedName` (string): The display name of the account. Console display name: "Updated Name".
* `workspace` (string): Workspace number from mParticle account. Console display name: "Workspace".


Example:
```terraform
resource "pingone_davinci_connector_instance" "mparticleConnector" {
  environment_id = var.pingone_environment_id

  connector = {
    id = "mparticleConnector"
  }
  name = "My awesome mparticleConnector"
  property {
    name  = "accountId"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_account_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "clientID"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_client_id
  }
  property {
    name  = "clientSecret"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_client_secret
  }
  property {
    name  = "displayName"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_display_name
  }
  property {
    name  = "jsonBody"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_json_body
  }
  property {
    name  = "nameOptional"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_name_optional
  }
  property {
    name  = "pod"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_pod
  }
  property {
    name  = "updatedName"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_updated_name
  }
  property {
    name  = "workspace"
    type  = "string"
    value = var.mparticleconnector_property_workspace
  }
}
```
